# Vidnexa Studio – full content

Website: https://vidnexastudio.com/  Contact: info@vidnexastudio.com

## Site FAQ

**What is Vidnexa Studio?**
Vidnexa Studio is an independent studio from India that makes Android apps, free online tools and browser games. Our apps are Vidnexa Player and Vidnexa: HD Video Downloader, with Papervo coming soon.

**Are the tools and games on this site free?**
Yes. All tools and games are free to use, with no sign-up or subscription. The site may show ads to cover running costs.

**Do I need to create an account?**
No. You can use every tool and game without an account.

**Are my files uploaded when I use a tool?**
No. Image, PDF, video and text tools run inside your browser, so your files and text stay on your device and are not sent to our servers.

**Do the tools work on a phone?**
Yes. Everything is designed to work on phones, tablets and computers. A few features, such as screen recording, depend on browser support and are mainly available on desktop browsers.

**What is Vidnexa Player?**
Vidnexa Player is our Android video player app. You can get it free on Google Play from the Apps page.

**What is Vidnexa HD Video Downloader?**
Vidnexa: HD Video Downloader is an Android app for saving videos you own or have permission to download. It is available on Google Play.

**Is there an iPhone version of the apps?**
Our apps are currently available for Android on Google Play. The web tools and games work on iPhone browsers too.

**How accurate are the calculators?**
They use standard formulas and give close estimates, but they are not financial, tax or medical advice. Please confirm important figures with a professional or your bank.

**How do I report a problem or suggest a tool?**
Write to us using the Contact page. Please include the tool name and a short description of the problem.

## Tools

### Word Counter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/word-counter/)
The Word Counter counts words, characters (with and without spaces), sentences, paragraphs and estimated reading time as you type or paste.

Writers, students and content teams use a word counter to stay inside limits such as 280 characters for a post, 160 for a meta description or 500 words for an essay. This tool updates live, so you can trim a sentence and see the numbers change at once. Reading time is estimated from an average adult reading speed, which makes it handy for blog posts and speeches. Everything is counted inside your browser, so private drafts are never sent to a server.

How to use:
1. Type or paste your text into the box.
2. Numbers update live as you type.
3. Press Clear to start again.

Tips:
- Paste your text, then delete the sentences you can live without and watch the count drop.
- Use the character count without spaces for SMS and form fields that ignore spaces.
- Check reading time before you publish; most readers stay for posts under five minutes.

Q: Does it count spaces?
A: It shows characters with spaces and without spaces, so you can use whichever your task needs.

Q: Is my text uploaded?
A: No. Everything is counted inside your browser and nothing is sent to a server.

Q: Is there a word limit?
A: No fixed limit. Very long texts of hundreds of thousands of words may slow an older phone, but normal documents are counted instantly.

Q: Are my words stored anywhere?
A: No. The counting happens on your device and the text is not uploaded or saved.

### Case Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/case-converter/)
The Case Converter changes text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, snake_case and more in one click.

Fixing text typed with Caps Lock on, formatting a headline or renaming variables for code are all quick jobs for a case converter. Paste your text, pick a style and copy the result. Title Case capitalises each word, Sentence case capitalises only the first letter of each sentence, and the developer styles join words without spaces. The conversion runs locally in your browser, so nothing you paste leaves your device.

How to use:
1. Paste your text.
2. Pick the case you want.
3. Copy the result.

Tips:
- Use Sentence case to repair text that was typed in all capitals.
- Choose camelCase or snake_case when you are naming variables or file names.
- Review Title Case results: small words such as 'of' and 'the' may need a manual fix to match your style guide.

Q: Which cases are supported?
A: UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case, Sentence case, camelCase, PascalCase, snake_case, kebab-case and aLtErNaTiNg.

Q: Does it work with Hindi text?
A: Hindi has no upper or lower case, so those letters stay as they are. English letters in the same text are converted.

Q: What is the difference between Title Case and Sentence case?
A: Title Case capitalises the first letter of every word, while Sentence case capitalises only the first word of each sentence and proper nouns you type yourself.

Q: Does it work with Hindi or other languages?
A: Case only applies to scripts that have upper and lower case, such as English. Hindi and other scripts without case stay unchanged.

### Lorem Ipsum Generator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/lorem-ipsum-generator/)
The Lorem Ipsum Generator creates placeholder paragraphs, sentences or words so you can fill a design or mockup before the real copy is ready.

Designers and developers use lorem ipsum because it looks like real text without distracting reviewers with meaning. Choose how many paragraphs, sentences or words you need, generate the text and copy it into your layout. It is useful for testing fonts, line lengths, card heights and responsive breakpoints. Generation happens in your browser instantly and there is nothing to install.

How to use:
1. Choose how many paragraphs, sentences or words.
2. Press Generate.
3. Copy the text into your design.

Tips:
- Generate a little more text than you need, then trim; it is easier than adding.
- Test both short and long blocks to see how your layout behaves with different amounts of text.
- Replace the placeholder with real copy before publishing, because search engines prefer meaningful content.

Q: What is Lorem Ipsum?
A: It is dummy text used by designers so a layout can be judged without real content.

Q: Is the text random?
A: Yes. Each press builds new text from a list of Latin-style words.

Q: What does lorem ipsum mean?
A: It is scrambled Latin-style filler text used since the 1500s by printers and designers as a stand-in for real content.

Q: Is it free to use in commercial projects?
A: Yes. Lorem ipsum is placeholder text with no copyright restrictions.

### Remove Duplicate Lines (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/remove-duplicate-lines/)
The Remove Duplicate Lines tool deletes repeated lines from a list and keeps each unique line once, in a single click.

Cleaning an email list, a keyword list, a set of URLs or log output often means getting rid of repeated lines. Paste your list, choose whether letter case and extra spaces should matter, and the tool returns only the unique lines in their original order. You can see how many duplicates were removed. All processing is local to your browser, so private lists stay private.

How to use:
1. Paste your list, one item per line.
2. Choose whether to ignore case, trim spaces and remove empty lines.
3. Press Remove duplicates and copy the result.

Tips:
- Turn on case-insensitive matching when 'Apple' and 'apple' should count as the same line.
- Trim spaces first if copied data has invisible trailing spaces.
- Sort the cleaned list afterwards with the Text Sorter if you need it in alphabetical order.

Q: Is the original order kept?
A: Yes. The first time a line appears it stays, and later copies are removed.

Q: How many lines can it handle?
A: Tens of thousands of lines work fine on a normal phone or computer.

Q: Does it keep the first or last copy of a line?
A: It keeps the first occurrence and removes the later repeats, so your original order is preserved.

Q: How many lines can I paste?
A: Tens of thousands of lines work fine on most devices. The limit is your browser's memory, not the site.

### Text Sorter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/text-sorter/)
The Text Sorter sorts lines A to Z, Z to A, by length, or shuffles them randomly, right in your browser.

Put names in alphabetical order, rank items by length or randomise a list for a draw. Paste one item per line, choose a sort mode and copy the result. Numbers can be sorted as text or by value depending on the option, and empty lines can be removed in the same step. Nothing is uploaded; sorting is done on your device.

How to use:
1. Paste your lines.
2. Choose a sort method.
3. Copy the sorted list.

Tips:
- Use the shuffle option to pick a random order for a giveaway or team list.
- Sort by length to find the shortest and longest items quickly.
- Combine with Remove Duplicate Lines to get a clean, ordered, unique list.

Q: Does it sort numbers correctly?
A: Yes. Numbers inside text are compared as numbers, so 2 comes before 10.

Q: Can I shuffle a list?
A: Yes. Pick Shuffle to put the lines in random order.

Q: Is the sorting case sensitive?
A: By default A to Z ignores letter case so 'apple' and 'Banana' sort naturally. Check the options on the tool for stricter modes.

Q: Can I sort numbers?
A: Yes. Use the numeric option so that 10 comes after 9 instead of after 1.

### Slug Generator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/slug-generator/)
The Slug Generator turns a title or phrase into a clean, lowercase, hyphen-separated URL slug that is safe for web addresses.

A good slug is short, readable and uses only lowercase letters, numbers and hyphens. Paste a blog title and the tool removes punctuation and accents, collapses spaces into hyphens and gives you a slug you can paste into your CMS. Short slugs that contain the main keyword are easier to read in search results and easier to share. The conversion runs locally in your browser.

How to use:
1. Type or paste your title.
2. Choose options such as removing small words.
3. Copy the slug.

Tips:
- Remove filler words such as 'a', 'the' and 'and' to keep the slug short.
- Do not change a slug after publishing unless you add a redirect from the old address.
- Use hyphens, not underscores; search engines treat hyphens as word separators.

Q: What is a slug?
A: The readable last part of a web address, like my-first-post.

Q: Are accents removed?
A: Yes. Letters like é become e so the link works everywhere.

Q: Why use hyphens instead of spaces in a URL?
A: Spaces become %20 in a URL, which looks messy. Hyphens keep the address readable and are the common convention.

Q: Does the slug affect SEO?
A: A short, descriptive slug helps users understand a link, and it is a small positive signal. Content quality matters far more.

### Text Reverser (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/text-reverser/)
The Text Reverser reverses the letters, the order of words, or the order of lines in any text you paste.

Reverse a word to check a palindrome, flip a list upside down or create mirrored text for fun. Choose reverse letters, reverse words or reverse lines, and the result appears immediately. It handles ordinary Unicode text, and everything is processed in your browser without uploading anything.

How to use:
1. Paste your text.
2. Pick a reverse mode.
3. Copy the result.

Tips:
- Use reverse lines to flip the order of a numbered list or a log.
- Compare the original and reversed text to test whether a phrase is a palindrome.
- Emoji made of several parts may flip in unexpected ways, so check the result.

Q: What is the difference between the modes?
A: Characters flips every letter. Words reverses word order. Each word flips letters inside each word. Lines reverses line order.

Q: Does it work with emoji?
A: Most emoji work. A few joined emoji may split when reversed.

Q: What is the difference between reversing letters and reversing words?
A: Reversing letters flips the whole text character by character, while reversing words keeps each word readable but changes their order.

Q: Will it work on Hindi text?
A: It reverses the characters, but joined characters in Hindi may not look correct when flipped, so it is best suited to English text.

### Text to Speech (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/text-to-speech/)
The Text to Speech tool reads any text aloud using the voices built into your device and browser, with adjustable speed and pitch.

Paste an email, a study note or an article and listen instead of reading. Pick a voice, set the speed and pitch and press play. The available voices and languages depend on your device and browser, so a phone, a laptop and a tablet may offer different options. Speech is generated locally by your browser's own speech engine and the text is not sent to our servers.

How to use:
1. Type or paste text.
2. Choose a voice and speed.
3. Press Speak.

Tips:
- Slow the speed down slightly when you are learning pronunciation.
- Break very long text into sections if the voice stops partway; some browsers limit one utterance.
- Try a different browser if you do not see a voice for your language.

Q: Which voices are available?
A: The voices come from your own device and browser, so the list is different on each phone or computer.

Q: Is any audio uploaded?
A: No. Speech is made on your device.

Q: Why do I see different voices on different devices?
A: The tool uses the voices installed on your device and browser, which differ between Android, iOS, Windows and macOS.

Q: Can I download the audio?
A: No. Browsers do not allow recording the built-in speech output directly, so the tool plays it aloud only.

### Typing Speed Test (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/typing-speed-test/)
The Typing Speed Test measures your typing speed in words per minute (WPM) and your accuracy in under a minute.

Type the shown passage as quickly and accurately as you can and see your WPM, accuracy and mistakes when the time ends. Typing speed is counted as one word for every five characters, which is the standard used by most typing tests. Practise a few minutes every day and your score will rise steadily. The test runs entirely in your browser and your results are not stored on our servers.

How to use:
1. Read the passage shown.
2. Start typing it in the box. The timer starts on your first key.
3. See your speed and accuracy at the end.

Tips:
- Focus on accuracy first; speed follows naturally once mistakes drop.
- Sit upright and keep your wrists relaxed to avoid strain.
- Try again on different days, as scores vary with practice and focus.

Q: How is WPM calculated?
A: Every 5 correct characters count as one word, divided by the minutes you took.

Q: Is a good score?
A: Around 40 WPM is typical. Above 60 WPM is quick.

Q: What is a good typing speed?
A: Most people type 35 to 45 WPM. Above 60 WPM is considered fast for office work, and professionals often reach 70 or more.

Q: How is WPM calculated?
A: Every five characters, including spaces, count as one word. WPM is that word count divided by the minutes taken.

### Age Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/age-calculator/)
The Age Calculator finds your exact age in years, months and days from your date of birth, and shows how many days until your next birthday.

Enter a date of birth and, if you like, a different date to measure against. The calculator takes leap years and different month lengths into account and returns your age in years, months and days, along with total months, weeks and days lived. It is useful for forms, school admissions, insurance and eligibility checks. The calculation is done in your browser and the dates are not stored.

How to use:
1. Pick your date of birth.
2. Optionally change the 'age on' date.
3. Read your exact age.

Tips:
- Change the 'age at' date to find out how old you will be on a future date, such as an exam or job deadline.
- Check the exact rules of a form; some count age on 1 January or 1 July.
- Use the Date Difference Calculator to count days between any two dates.

Q: Can I check age on a past or future date?
A: Yes. Change the 'Age on date' field.

Q: Is my date of birth stored?
A: No. The calculation happens in your browser only.

Q: Does it handle leap years?
A: Yes. Leap days and varying month lengths are included in the calculation.

Q: Can I find the age on a past or future date?
A: Yes. Enter any date in the 'age at' field to see the age on that day.

### EMI Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/emi-calculator/)
The EMI Calculator works out your monthly loan instalment, total interest and total payment from the loan amount, interest rate and tenure.

EMI stands for equated monthly instalment, the fixed amount you pay every month on a home, car or personal loan. Enter the principal, the annual interest rate and the tenure in months or years, and the calculator shows the EMI, the total interest paid and a year by year schedule of principal and balance. Try different tenures to see how a longer loan lowers the EMI but raises total interest. Results are estimates, and your bank's figure may differ because of fees and rounding.

How to use:
1. Enter the loan amount.
2. Enter the yearly interest rate and the tenure.
3. See your monthly EMI and the full breakup.

Tips:
- Compare 15 and 20 year tenures to see how much extra interest a longer loan costs.
- A small extra payment toward principal each year can shorten the loan significantly.
- Remember to add processing fees and insurance when comparing offers.

Q: How is EMI calculated?
A: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n ÷ ((1+r)^n − 1), where r is the monthly rate and n is the number of months.

Q: Will my bank show the same number?
A: It can differ slightly because of processing fees and rounding.

Q: What formula does the EMI calculator use?
A: EMI = P × r × (1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n − 1), where P is the loan amount, r is the monthly interest rate and n is the number of months.

Q: Why is my bank's EMI slightly different?
A: Banks may round differently, add fees or change the rate during the loan. Treat the result here as a close estimate.

### Percentage Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/percentage-calculator/)
The Percentage Calculator finds a percentage of a number, what percent one number is of another, and the percentage increase or decrease between two values.

Use it for discounts, marks, tips, tax, growth rates and price changes. Choose the type of question, fill in the numbers and read the answer with a short explanation of the formula. For example, 20% of 450 is 90, and a rise from 80 to 100 is a 25% increase. The calculation happens in your browser and nothing is saved.

How to use:
1. Pick the question that matches yours.
2. Fill in the two numbers.
3. The answer appears straight away.

Tips:
- For a percentage change, always divide the difference by the original value, not the new one.
- A 50% increase followed by a 50% decrease does not bring you back to the start.
- Use the Discount Calculator when you want the final price after an offer.

Q: How do I find the percentage increase?
A: Subtract the old value from the new value, divide by the old value and multiply by 100.

Q: Can I use decimals?
A: Yes, decimals are fine.

Q: How do I calculate X% of a number?
A: Multiply the number by X and divide by 100. For example, 15% of 200 is 200 × 15 ÷ 100 = 30.

Q: How do I find percentage increase?
A: Subtract the old value from the new one, divide by the old value and multiply by 100.

### BMI Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/bmi-calculator/)
The BMI Calculator estimates your body mass index from height and weight and shows which standard range it falls into, with a healthy weight range for your height.

BMI is your weight in kilograms divided by your height in metres squared. Adults are generally grouped as underweight below 18.5, normal from 18.5 to 24.9, overweight from 25 to 29.9 and obese at 30 and above. Some health guidelines for South Asian adults use lower cut-offs, so ask a doctor which applies to you. BMI is a simple screening number and does not measure body fat, muscle or overall health. It is not medical advice.

How to use:
1. Enter your height in centimetres.
2. Enter your weight in kilograms.
3. Read your BMI and category.

Tips:
- Measure height without shoes and weight in light clothing for a better estimate.
- Muscular people may have a high BMI without excess body fat.
- Talk to a doctor or dietitian before making health decisions based on BMI.

Q: Is BMI accurate for everyone?
A: No. It is a rough screening number and ignores muscle, age and body type.

Q: Is this medical advice?
A: No. Please ask a doctor about your health.

Q: Is BMI accurate for everyone?
A: No. It is a rough screening tool and ignores muscle, bone density, age and body shape.

Q: Can I use it for children?
A: Not reliably. Children's BMI is judged against age and sex charts, so please ask a paediatrician.

### SIP Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/sip-calculator/)
The SIP Calculator estimates the future value of a monthly SIP investment from the monthly amount, expected annual return and number of years.

A systematic investment plan puts a fixed amount into a fund every month. Enter your monthly amount, the return you expect and the period, and the calculator shows the total invested, the estimated gains and the final value. It makes the effect of compounding easy to see: starting earlier and staying invested longer matters more than the exact return. Actual returns of market-linked investments vary and are never guaranteed, so treat the result as an illustration, not a promise or financial advice.

How to use:
1. Enter the monthly amount.
2. Enter the expected yearly return and years.
3. See invested amount, returns and total value.

Tips:
- Try the same monthly amount over 10, 15 and 20 years to see how compounding grows.
- Use a conservative return when planning for important goals.
- Increase your SIP a little each year to reach your goal sooner.

Q: Are the returns guaranteed?
A: No. Market returns change. The result is only an estimate.

Q: Is this financial advice?
A: No. It is a simple calculator for planning ideas.

Q: Are the SIP returns guaranteed?
A: No. Market-linked returns go up and down. The calculator only shows what would happen if the entered rate were earned every year.

Q: What return rate should I enter?
A: Use a realistic, cautious figure. Check the long term history of the type of fund you are considering, and remember that past returns do not guarantee future ones.

### GST Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/gst-calculator/)
The GST Calculator adds GST to a price or removes it from a GST-inclusive price, and splits the tax into CGST and SGST.

Enter the amount and the GST rate, such as 5%, 12%, 18% or 28%, and choose whether to add or remove GST. The tool returns the net price, the total GST and the CGST and SGST halves used for sales within the same state. It is useful for invoices, shop billing and checking a price quoted with tax. Rates change, so confirm the current rate for your product or service with the official GST notifications or your accountant.

How to use:
1. Enter the amount.
2. Choose the GST rate and whether GST is included.
3. See the net, tax and total amounts.

Tips:
- Choose 'remove GST' when the price you have already includes tax.
- For sales between states IGST applies instead of the CGST and SGST split.
- Always confirm the correct rate for your item with an accountant or the official GST rate list.

Q: What are the GST rates?
A: The tool offers 3%, 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%. Check the latest rate for your product with official sources.

Q: What is the CGST and SGST split?
A: For sales inside one state the GST is divided equally between the centre and the state.

Q: What is the difference between CGST, SGST and IGST?
A: CGST goes to the central government and SGST to the state when a sale is within one state. IGST is charged for sales between states.

Q: How do I remove GST from a price?
A: Divide the GST-inclusive price by (1 + rate/100). For 18% GST, divide by 1.18.

### Discount Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/discount-calculator/)
The Discount Calculator shows the final price after a percentage discount and how much money you save.

Enter the original price and the discount percentage to see the sale price and the saving. You can also add a second discount, such as an extra coupon, to see the combined effect. Remember that two discounts of 20% and 10% do not equal 30%, because the second applies to the already reduced price. The calculation is done locally and nothing is saved.

How to use:
1. Enter the original price.
2. Enter the discount percentage (and an extra one if any).
3. See what you pay and what you save.

Tips:
- Compare offers by the final price, not just the percentage.
- Add shipping and taxes before deciding which deal is cheaper.
- Remember that stacked discounts apply one after another.

Q: How does a second discount work?
A: The second discount is applied on the already reduced price, not the original.

Q: Can I use it for sale shopping?
A: Yes, it is great for quick checks.

Q: How do I calculate a discount?
A: Multiply the price by the discount percentage and divide by 100 to get the saving, then subtract it from the price.

Q: Is a 20% plus 10% discount the same as 30%?
A: No. 20% off then 10% off equals 28% off, because the 10% applies to the reduced price.

### Date Difference Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/date-difference-calculator/)
The Date Difference Calculator tells you the number of days, weeks, months and years between two dates.

Pick a start date and an end date to see the gap as total days and as years, months and days. It is helpful for project deadlines, notice periods, pregnancy or trip countdowns, and counting days since an event. You can choose to include the end date in the count. The calculation uses your browser and no dates are stored.

How to use:
1. Pick the start date.
2. Pick the end date.
3. Read the difference.

Tips:
- Tick the include-end-date option if both the first and last day should count.
- Use it to count working timelines, but remember it does not skip weekends or holidays.
- Use the Age Calculator when one of the dates is a birth date.

Q: Is the end date included?
A: The result is the gap between the two dates. Add one day if you want to count both.

Q: Can the start date be later?
A: Yes. The tool swaps them for you.

Q: Does it include the last day?
A: By default it counts the difference between the dates. Enable the include-end-date option to count both days.

Q: Does it skip weekends?
A: No. It counts calendar days, including weekends and holidays.

### Simple & Compound Interest Calculator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/interest-calculator/)
The Interest Calculator computes simple or compound interest and the final amount from the principal, rate and time.

With simple interest the amount earned stays the same every year, calculated on the original principal. With compound interest you earn interest on previously earned interest, so savings grow faster. Choose the type, enter the principal, rate and period and, for compound interest, the compounding frequency. The result shows the interest earned and the maturity amount. Check your bank's own terms, as actual interest may be calculated differently.

How to use:
1. Enter principal, rate and years.
2. Choose simple interest or a compounding period.
3. See interest earned and maturity amount.

Tips:
- Use compound interest to estimate fixed deposits and savings; use simple interest for many short term loans.
- Choose quarterly compounding to match many bank deposits.
- Compare the same amount over 5 and 10 years to see compounding at work.

Q: What is the difference?
A: Simple interest is only on the principal. Compound interest is also on interest already earned.

Q: Does it work for FD?
A: It gives a good estimate for a fixed deposit. Banks may round differently.

Q: What is the formula for compound interest?
A: A = P(1 + r/n)^(nt), where P is the principal, r the annual rate, n the compounding periods per year and t the years.

Q: What is the formula for simple interest?
A: Simple interest = P × R × T ÷ 100, where P is the principal, R the yearly rate and T the time in years.

### Unit Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/unit-converter/)
The Unit Converter converts length, weight, area, volume, speed, data size and temperature between common units instantly.

Pick a category, enter a value and see it converted into other units at the same time, such as kilometres to miles, kilograms to pounds, acres to square metres, litres to gallons or Celsius to Fahrenheit. Data units include bytes, kilobytes, megabytes and gigabytes. It is handy for cooking, travel, shopping and studying. The conversion runs in your browser using standard conversion factors.

How to use:
1. Choose the type of unit.
2. Enter a value and pick From and To.
3. Read the converted result.

Tips:
- Use the swap button to reverse the conversion direction quickly.
- For temperature, remember that conversions are not a simple multiplication.
- Check whether a recipe or document uses US or UK gallons and cups, as they differ.

Q: Is bigha accurate?
A: A bigha changes from state to state. The tool uses one common value, so check local records for land deals.

Q: Which temperature units work?
A: Celsius, Fahrenheit and Kelvin.

Q: How many kilometres are in a mile?
A: One mile is about 1.609 kilometres.

Q: Does it support Indian units like acre or bigha?
A: It supports acre and square metre style area units. Local units such as bigha vary by state, so they are not included.

### Random Number Generator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/random-number-generator/)
The Random Number Generator picks one or many random numbers between a minimum and maximum you choose, with or without repeats.

Use it for draws, games, classroom activities, sampling or choosing who goes first. Set the range, how many numbers you need and whether repeats are allowed, then press generate. It uses your browser's built-in random source. For anything that needs cryptographic security, such as passwords, use the Password Generator instead.

How to use:
1. Set the minimum and maximum.
2. Choose how many numbers.
3. Press Generate.

Tips:
- Turn off repeats to draw unique numbers, like a lottery or raffle.
- Generate a sorted list if you want an ordered result.
- For passwords and keys use the Password Generator, which is designed for security.

Q: Is it truly random?
A: It uses your browser's secure random generator, which is far better than a simple formula.

Q: Can I avoid repeats?
A: Yes, tick 'No repeats'.

Q: Is the number truly random?
A: It is pseudo-random, produced by your browser, which is fine for games and draws but is not meant for security uses.

Q: Can I get numbers without repeats?
A: Yes. Choose the unique option and the tool draws each number only once.

### Online Stopwatch (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/stopwatch/)
The Stopwatch is a simple online timer that counts up in hours, minutes, seconds and hundredths, with lap times.

Press start to begin timing, record laps while it keeps running, and pause or reset whenever you like. It is useful for workouts, cooking, study sessions, presentations and games. The timer runs in your browser tab, so keep the tab open for the most accurate result, as some phones slow background tabs.

How to use:
1. Press Start.
2. Press Lap to record a split.
3. Press Pause or Reset when done.

Tips:
- Keep the page open and the screen awake for long timings.
- Use laps to record intervals without stopping the clock.
- Write down your times, because they are not saved after you close the page.

Q: Does it keep running if I switch tabs?
A: Yes. It measures real clock time, so the total stays correct.

Q: Is there a sound?
A: No sound is played.

Q: Does the stopwatch keep running if I switch tabs?
A: It keeps counting from the real clock, but some browsers pause updates in background tabs. The time will catch up when you return.

Q: Are lap times saved?
A: No. They exist only while the page is open.

### Image Compressor (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/image-compressor/)
The Image Compressor reduces the file size of JPG, PNG and WebP photos right in your browser, without uploading them anywhere.

Large images slow down websites and fail upload limits on forms and email. Choose your images, set the quality, and compare the original and compressed size before you download. JPG and WebP are compressed by lowering quality, which gives the biggest savings for photos. Because processing happens on your own device, your photos stay private and there is no waiting for uploads.

How to use:
1. Choose one or more images.
2. Set the quality and output format.
3. Download the smaller files.

Tips:
- A quality of 70 to 80 percent usually looks the same but is much smaller.
- Resize large photos first with the Image Resizer for even bigger savings.
- Use WebP for websites; it is typically smaller than JPG at similar quality.

Q: Are my photos uploaded?
A: No. Compression runs inside your browser.

Q: Which quality should I use?
A: Around 70 to 80 usually keeps photos looking good and cuts size a lot.

Q: Is the quality reduced?
A: A little, depending on the quality you choose. At moderate settings the difference is rarely visible.

Q: Are my photos uploaded to a server?
A: No. The compression is done inside your browser, so the photos never leave your device.

### Image Resizer (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/image-resizer/)
The Image Resizer changes the width and height of an image in pixels, with an option to keep the aspect ratio.

Resize photos for profile pictures, forms, social posts and web pages. Enter a new width or height, or a percentage, and the other side follows automatically when the aspect ratio is locked. Download the result as JPG, PNG or WebP. Resizing is done in your browser and your picture is not uploaded.

How to use:
1. Choose an image.
2. Enter the new width or height.
3. Press Resize & download.

Tips:
- Keep the aspect ratio locked to avoid stretched pictures.
- Make images smaller rather than larger, because enlarging makes them blurry.
- Follow the exact pixel size requested by the form or website you are uploading to.

Q: Does it keep the aspect ratio?
A: Yes, when 'Keep proportions' is ticked.

Q: Is there a size limit?
A: Up to 10000 pixels on each side, or whatever your device memory allows.

Q: Will resizing reduce the quality?
A: Making an image smaller keeps it sharp. Enlarging it can make it look soft, because new pixels must be guessed.

Q: What size should I use for the web?
A: For most web pages 1200 to 1600 pixels wide is enough. Use smaller sizes for thumbnails and icons.

### Image Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/image-converter/)
The Image Converter converts pictures between PNG, JPG and WebP formats right in your browser.

Choose an image, pick the output format and download the new file. JPG is best for photos, PNG keeps sharp edges and transparency, and WebP is a modern format that is usually smaller on websites. When converting a transparent PNG to JPG, the transparent area becomes a solid background. Conversion runs on your device, so nothing is uploaded.

How to use:
1. Choose the format you want.
2. Add your images.
3. Download each converted file.

Tips:
- Choose PNG for logos and screenshots with text.
- Choose JPG or WebP for photographs to keep the file small.
- Remember that JPG does not support transparency.

Q: Why does PNG to JPG get a white background?
A: JPG has no transparency, so transparent areas are filled with white.

Q: Can I convert many at once?
A: Yes. Add several files.

Q: Which format should I choose?
A: Use JPG for photos, PNG for graphics needing transparency, and WebP when you want small files for a website.

Q: Does converting reduce quality?
A: Converting to JPG or WebP can lose a little quality because those formats compress. PNG keeps the pixels exactly.

### Image to Base64 (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/image-to-base64/)
The Image to Base64 tool turns an image into a Base64 data URI that you can paste straight into HTML, CSS or JSON.

A data URI lets you embed a small image directly in code without a separate file, which can save a request for tiny icons. Choose an image and copy either the full data URI or just the Base64 text. Base64 makes files about one third larger, so it is best for small images only. Conversion happens in your browser.

How to use:
1. Choose an image.
2. Copy the Base64 text.
3. Paste it where you need it.

Tips:
- Use it only for small icons, not big photos.
- Compress the image first to keep the Base64 string short.
- Copy the full data URI when pasting into an img tag or CSS url().

Q: When is Base64 useful?
A: For tiny icons inside CSS or HTML so no extra file request is needed.

Q: Is the image uploaded?
A: No.

Q: Why is the Base64 text larger than the image?
A: Base64 represents binary data using text characters, which makes it about 33 percent larger.

Q: Is the image uploaded?
A: No. The conversion is done locally in your browser.

### PDF Editor (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/pdf-editor/)
The PDF Editor lets you click on existing text and change it in the same font, size and colour, and also add text, images, a drawn signature, ticks, highlights and white boxes, all in your browser.

Use Edit text, click any line on the page and type the change. The tool reads the font, size and colour of that line, hides the old words and writes the new ones in the PDF's own font when it holds the letters you typed. If it does not, a very close matching font is used instead. You can also fill a form that is not fillable, sign a letter, or highlight important lines. Because the PDF is opened and saved on your own device, private documents such as bank forms and ID copies are not uploaded and there is no page or size limit set by the site. The old words are covered, not deleted: they stay hidden in the file and could still be found by copying or searching, so do not use it to hide private information.

How to use:
1. Choose a PDF.
2. Pick Edit text and click a line to change it, or pick Add text, Whiteout, Highlight, Add image or Sign, then click on the page.
3. Drag the handle to move an item and the corner square to resize it.
4. Press Download edited PDF.

Tips:
- Use Edit text for small corrections such as a date, a name or an amount.
- Press Enter when you finish a line, then check the page before downloading.
- Draw your signature slowly on a phone or with a mouse; the tool trims the empty space for you.

Q: Can I change the existing text in a PDF?
A: You can cover old text with Whiteout and type new text on top. Changing the original text directly is not possible in a browser-only tool.

Q: Is my PDF uploaded?
A: No. Everything happens on your device.

Q: Can I edit the original text of a PDF?
A: Yes, line by line. Choose Edit text, click the line and type. The new text is written in the same font when the PDF contains the letters, otherwise in a close matching font. The old text is covered, not removed from the file, so it can still be found by copy or search.

Q: Will the new text look exactly the same?
A: Usually yes for common fonts such as Arial, Times New Roman, Calibri and Courier. A very decorative or custom font may look slightly different, and the page background behind the text is matched by colour, so photos or gradients can show a faint patch.

Q: Which characters can I type?
A: Basic Latin letters, numbers and common symbols. Hindi and other scripts cannot be typed yet.

Q: Does Edit text work on scanned PDFs?
A: No. A scan is a picture, so there are no words to select. Use Whiteout and Add text on top instead.

### Base64 Encoder & Decoder (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/base64-encoder-decoder/)
The Base64 Encoder Decoder converts text to Base64 and decodes Base64 text back to the original, with Unicode support.

Base64 turns data into plain text characters so it can travel safely in URLs, emails, JSON and HTML. Paste text to encode or a Base64 string to decode and see the result at once. Base64 is not encryption, so do not use it to hide secrets. The tool runs in your browser and handles non-English characters correctly.

How to use:
1. Paste your text.
2. Press Encode or Decode.
3. Copy the result.

Tips:
- Remember that Base64 is encoding, not security.
- If decoding fails, check for missing characters or extra spaces.
- Use the Image to Base64 tool when you want to encode a picture.

Q: Does it support Hindi and emoji?
A: Yes. Text is handled as UTF-8.

Q: Is Base64 encryption?
A: No. It is only an encoding and anyone can decode it.

Q: Is Base64 secure?
A: No. Anyone can decode it, so it should never be used to protect passwords or private data.

Q: Why does decoding show strange characters?
A: The data may not be text, or the string may be damaged. Check that it is copied completely.

### URL Encoder & Decoder (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/url-encoder-decoder/)
The URL Encoder Decoder percent-encodes text so it is safe in a web address, or decodes percent-encoded text back to normal.

Characters such as spaces, ampersands and non-English letters must be encoded in URLs, for example a space becomes %20. Paste your text or URL, choose encode or decode and copy the result. It is useful for query strings, links in emails and debugging redirects. The conversion runs in your browser.

How to use:
1. Paste text or a URL.
2. Press Encode or Decode.
3. Copy the result.

Tips:
- Encode only the value parts of a query string, not the whole URL.
- Decode a copied link to read what it really contains.
- Check that plus signs and %20 are handled the way your server expects.

Q: Why encode a URL?
A: Spaces and symbols are not allowed in links, so they are replaced with % codes.

Q: Which function does it use?
A: encodeURIComponent and decodeURIComponent.

Q: What does %20 mean in a URL?
A: It is the encoded form of a space character.

Q: When should I encode a URL?
A: Whenever a link contains spaces, symbols or non-English letters in its path or query string.

### Colour Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/color-converter/)
The Color Converter converts colours between HEX, RGB and HSL and shows a live preview of the colour.

Type a HEX code such as #7C3AED, or enter RGB or HSL values, and the other formats update at once. Designers and developers use it to move colours between design tools and CSS. Use the picker to explore and copy the exact value you need. Conversions are calculated locally in your browser.

- Copy the format your CSS or design tool expects.

Q: What is HEX?
A: A six-digit code like #7C3AED that stands for red, green and blue.

Q: Can I type a short HEX like #fff?
A: Yes.

Q: What is the difference between HEX, RGB and HSL?
A: They describe the same colour in different ways: HEX is a compact code, RGB mixes red, green and blue, and HSL uses hue, saturation and lightness.

Q: Can I use 3-digit HEX codes?
A: Yes. A short code like #07f is the same as #0077ff.

### UUID Generator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/uuid-generator/)
The UUID Generator creates random version 4 UUIDs, one at a time or in bulk, ready to copy.

A UUID is a 128-bit identifier that is practically unique, commonly used as a database key or request ID. Choose how many you need and copy them as a list. They are generated using your browser's secure random source and nothing is stored or sent. Version 4 UUIDs are random and carry no information about time or device.

How to use:
1. Enter how many you need.
2. Press Generate.
3. Copy them.

Tips:
- Generate in bulk when you need seed data for tests.
- Use lowercase consistently if you compare IDs as text.
- Do not use a UUID as a secret; it is an identifier, not a password.

Q: Can two UUIDs be the same?
A: It is so unlikely that for practical purposes it never happens.

Q: Which version is made?
A: Version 4 (random).

Q: Can two UUIDs be the same?
A: It is theoretically possible but so unlikely that it is ignored in practice.

Q: What is a version 4 UUID?
A: It is a UUID built from random numbers, as opposed to versions based on time or names.

### Hash Generator (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/hash-generator/)
The Hash Generator creates SHA-1, SHA-256, SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashes of any text in your browser.

A hash is a fixed-length fingerprint of data. Type or paste text and see all hashes immediately, which is useful for checking integrity or comparing values. The same input always gives the same hash and a tiny change gives a completely different one. Hashes cannot be reversed, but plain SHA hashes are not suitable for storing passwords. Hashing uses your browser's built-in crypto and nothing is uploaded.

How to use:
1. Type or paste text.
2. Hashes appear straight away.
3. Copy the one you need.

Tips:
- Use SHA-256 or higher for new work; SHA-1 is considered weak.
- Watch for hidden spaces or line breaks that change the hash.
- Use a dedicated password hashing method such as bcrypt or Argon2 for passwords.

Q: Why is there no MD5?
A: Browsers do not include MD5. SHA-256 is the better choice today.

Q: Is hashing the same as encryption?
A: No. A hash cannot be turned back into the text.

Q: Can a hash be reversed?
A: No. Hashing is one way, though short or common inputs can be guessed.

Q: Which hash should I use?
A: SHA-256 is a good default. Avoid SHA-1 for security purposes.

### Unix Timestamp Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/timestamp-converter/)
The Timestamp Converter converts a Unix timestamp to a readable date and a date back to a Unix timestamp, in your local time and UTC.

Unix time counts the seconds since 1 January 1970 UTC and is used in logs, databases and APIs. Paste a timestamp in seconds or milliseconds to see the date, or pick a date to get its timestamp. The current timestamp is also shown. The conversion is done in your browser using your device's time zone and UTC.

How to use:
1. Paste a timestamp, or pick a date.
2. Read UTC, local and ISO formats.
3. Copy what you need.

Tips:
- A 10-digit number is usually seconds and a 13-digit number is milliseconds.
- Always check whether a value is shown in UTC or local time.
- Store dates as UTC timestamps and convert them only for display.

Q: Seconds or milliseconds?
A: The tool detects both. Numbers below 100 billion are treated as seconds.

Q: Which time zone is used?
A: Both UTC and your device's local time are shown.

Q: What is a Unix timestamp?
A: It is the number of seconds that have passed since 1 January 1970 at 00:00 UTC.

Q: Seconds or milliseconds?
A: Ten digits usually mean seconds and thirteen digits usually mean milliseconds.

### Video Trimmer (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/video-trimmer/)
The Video Trimmer cuts the start and end off a video and saves just the part you want, in your browser.

Pick a video, set the start and end points with the sliders or time boxes and preview the section before saving. The video is processed inside your browser, so the file is never uploaded, and processing runs in real time, so a longer video takes longer. Use it to remove awkward beginnings, shorten clips for status updates or keep only a favourite moment.

How to use:
1. Choose a video and play it to find your moments.
2. Enter the start and end time, or use the current time buttons.
3. Press Trim video and download the clip.

Tips:
- Preview the clip before saving to check your cut points.
- Trim before compressing for the smallest final file.
- Keep the tab open until the download appears.

Q: Is the video uploaded?
A: No. Trimming happens on your device.

Q: Is it exact to the frame?
A: It is accurate to about a tenth of a second, which is fine for most clips.

Q: Why is the clip WebM?
A: Browsers record in WebM (or MP4 on Safari). WebM plays in Chrome, Edge, Firefox, VLC and most phones.

Q: Can I cut from the middle of a video?
A: The trimmer keeps one section, from your start point to your end point. Trim twice if you need to remove a middle part.

Q: What format is the result?
A: It depends on your browser, usually WebM or MP4.

### Video Speed Changer (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/video-speed-changer/)
The Video Speed Changer makes a video faster or plays it in slow motion and saves the result, in your browser.

Choose a speed from 0.25x slow motion up to 4x fast forward and download the new video. The video is processed inside your browser, so the file is never uploaded, and processing runs in real time, so a longer video takes longer. It is great for time-lapse effects, tutorials and dramatic slow-motion clips. Audio speed changes along with the video.

How to use:
1. Choose a video.
2. Pick a speed from 0.5x to 2x.
3. Press Change speed and download when it finishes.

Tips:
- Use 0.5x for gentle slow motion and 2x for a quick time-lapse.
- Short clips work best for creative effects.
- Keep the tab open until processing finishes.

Q: Does the sound change pitch?
A: Browsers try to keep the voice pitch natural, but very slow or fast speeds can sound odd. You can remove the sound if you prefer.

Q: How long does it take?
A: It runs at the new speed, so a video sped up to 2x finishes in half the time.

Q: Is my video uploaded?
A: No. Everything runs on your device.

Q: Does the sound change too?
A: Yes. The audio plays faster or slower along with the video.

Q: Is anything uploaded?
A: No. Everything stays on your device.

### Video to GIF Converter (https://vidnexastudio.com/tools/video-to-gif/)
The Video to GIF tool turns a short moment of a video into an animated GIF in your browser.

Choose a video, select the start time, length, size and frame rate, and download your GIF. GIFs get large quickly, so keep clips to a few seconds and reduce the width for sharing. A lower frame rate and smaller size produce smaller files. The GIF is built on your device and the video is not uploaded.

How to use:
1. Choose a video and set the start time.
2. Pick the length, width and frames per second.
3. Press Make GIF, check the preview and download it.

Tips:
- Keep GIFs under about 5 seconds for a reasonable file size.
- Reduce the width to 480 pixels or less for chat and social sharing.
- Use 10 to 12 frames per second to balance smoothness and size.

Q: How long can the GIF be?
A: Up to 10 seconds. GIF files grow very fast, so short clips at 320 px wide work best.

Q: Why is my GIF large?
A: GIF is an old format. Lower the width, the frames per second or the length to shrink it.

Q: Is it uploaded?
A: No. Frames are captured and the GIF is built inside your browser.

Q: Why is my GIF so large?
A: GIF is an old format that stores every frame as an image. Shorten the clip, shrink the width or lower the frame rate.

Q: Does the GIF have sound?
A: No. GIF files cannot contain audio.

Only extract audio from videos you own or have permission to use.

How to use:

Tips:
- Use it only on videos you have the rights to.

- Trim the video first if you only need part of the audio.

Q: Can I get an MP3?
A: Not directly. Browsers cannot make MP3 files on their own, so you get WAV or WebM/Opus audio. Most players and editors open both.

Q: Which option should I choose?
A: WAV is quick and works well for short clips. WebM/Opus makes a much smaller file but runs at normal speed.

Q: Is my video uploaded?
A: No. The audio is extracted on your device.

Q: What audio format do I get?
A: A WAV file, which keeps full quality but is larger than MP3.

Q: Is the video uploaded?
A: No. The audio is extracted on your device.

## Games

### Ludo (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/ludo/)
Ludo is the classic Indian board game of dice and tokens. Each player has four tokens that start in a base, and you need a 6 to bring a token onto the track. Tokens travel clockwise around the board and then up their own coloured home column into the centre. Landing on an opponent sends it back to its base unless it is standing on a safe square, and the first player to bring all four tokens home wins. This version lets you play 2 or 4 players against the computer or pass the phone between friends.

Q: How do I get a token out of the base?
A: Roll a 6. A 6 also gives you another turn, but three 6s in a row lose the turn.

Q: Which squares are safe?
A: The four start squares and the four star squares. A token standing there cannot be captured.

Q: Do I need the exact number to finish?
A: Yes. A token in the home column moves only if the roll fits exactly into the centre.

Q: Can I play with friends?
A: Yes. Choose With friends and pass the phone around. Each colour takes its turn.

Q: Does the computer cheat?
A: No. It rolls the same random dice as you and simply picks a sensible move.

### Carrom (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/carrom/)
Carrom is a tabletop game from India where you flick a heavy striker to knock small wooden coins into the four corner pockets. In this browser version you play white against the computer. Drag the striker along your baseline, pull back to aim and set the power, and release to shoot. Pocket your own coins to keep your turn, avoid pocketing the striker, and cover the red queen with one of your coins to claim her. The first player to pocket all nine coins wins.

Q: How do I aim?
A: Press on the striker and drag away from the direction you want to shoot, like pulling a catapult. The dotted line shows the direction and the red line shows the power.

Q: What happens if I pocket the striker?
A: It is a foul. One of your pocketed coins is placed back in the centre and your turn ends.

Q: What is the queen?
A: The red coin. If you pocket her, you must pocket one of your own coins in the same turn to cover her, otherwise she returns to the centre.

Q: Can I play with a friend?
A: Not yet. This version is you against the computer with three skill levels.

### Block Puzzle (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/block-puzzle/)
Block Puzzle is a calm puzzle game played on an 8 by 8 board. You get three pieces at a time and drag each one onto the board where it fits. Pieces cannot be rotated, so you have to plan. When a row or a column is completely filled it clears and you score. Clearing several lines at once, or clearing on consecutive moves, scores more. The game has no timer and ends only when none of your pieces fits anywhere.

Q: Can I rotate the pieces?
A: No. Each piece must be placed as shown, which is what makes the puzzle interesting.

Q: How is the score calculated?
A: One point per block placed, plus a bonus for every line cleared. Multiple lines in one move and combos on consecutive moves add extra.

Q: Is there a time limit?
A: No. Take as long as you like.

Q: What is a good strategy?
A: Keep the board open, avoid leaving single holes, and save a straight line of space for the long five-block piece.

### Bubble Shooter (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/bubble-shooter/)
Bubble Shooter is a classic aim-and-pop puzzle. A shooter at the bottom fires coloured bubbles into a honeycomb of bubbles at the top. When the bubble you shoot touches three or more of the same colour, the whole group pops, and any bubbles left hanging without support fall down for extra points. Every few shots a new row is pushed in from the top, so you have to keep clearing. Pop the whole board to finish a level and start the next one with more colours.

Q: How do I aim?
A: Move your finger or mouse to point the dotted line, then release or click to shoot. On a keyboard use the arrow keys and Space.

Q: Can I bounce the bubble off the walls?
A: Yes. Aim at a side wall to reach bubbles hidden behind others.

Q: What are the levels?
A: The board is refilled with a bigger mix of colours each time you clear it. Hard mode starts with more rows and colours.

Q: When is the game over?
A: When the bubbles reach the dotted line near the bottom.

### Cricket Batting (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/cricket/)
Cricket Batting is a quick timing game. The bowler runs in and the ball comes down the pitch, and your job is to tap exactly when it reaches the bat. Perfect timing sends the ball for six, slightly early or late gives a four or a couple of runs, and a very early or very late swing can get you bowled or caught. Choose a 2 over or 5 over innings to set a high score, or Chase mode to beat a random target within 2 overs and 3 wickets.

Q: When should I tap?
A: When the ball is in the yellow zone in front of the bat. Tap Hit, tap the pitch or press Space.

Q: Why did I get out?
A: Swinging far too early or far too late loses a wicket. Letting the ball go through without a swing is bowled.

Q: How many wickets do I have?
A: Three in every mode.

Q: Does the bowling get harder?
A: Yes. Hard bowling is faster and the timing window is smaller. Easy is slower and more forgiving.

### Snake (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/snake/)
Snake is a classic arcade game where you steer a growing snake to eat apples without hitting walls, rocks or yourself. This version has three modes: Classic, Wrap-around and Rocks. Golden stars give 3 points but vanish quickly. Your best score is saved in your own browser.

Q: How do I control the snake?
A: Use the arrow keys or WASD on a keyboard, or swipe on the board on a phone.

Q: What are the game modes?
A: Classic has deadly walls, Wrap-around lets you pass through the edges and Rocks adds new obstacles as you grow.

Q: What are the golden stars?
A: A golden star gives 3 points, but it disappears fast, so grab it only when the path is safe.

### 2048 (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/2048/)
2048 is a sliding number puzzle. Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide every tile, and when two tiles with the same number touch they merge into one with double the value. Reach 2048, then keep going for a higher score. You can undo a slip with Undo or the Z key.

Q: How do I play 2048?
A: Slide tiles with the arrow keys or by swiping. Equal tiles merge when they collide.

Q: Can I undo a move?
A: Yes. Use the Undo button or press Z.

Q: Can I keep playing after reaching 2048?
A: Yes. You can continue and try for 4096 and beyond.

### Memory Match (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/memory-match/)
Memory Match is a card-flipping game with levels. Flip two cards at a time and find every pair; fewer moves earn more stars. Each level unlocks after you finish the one before, and levels 10 to 12 give you only a limited number of moves.

Q: How do I play Memory Match?
A: Pick a level, flip two cards at a time and find every matching pair.

Q: How do I earn more stars?
A: Finish with fewer moves. Levels 10 to 12 also have a move limit.

Q: Do I have to unlock levels?
A: Yes. Each level unlocks after you finish the previous one.

### Tic Tac Toe (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/tic-tac-toe/)
Tic Tac Toe is the classic game of X and O. Choose a board size and an opponent, then get 3 in a row on the 3 by 3 board, or 4 in a row on the bigger boards. Hard mode on 3 by 3 never loses, so a draw is a great result.

Q: How do I win at Tic Tac Toe?
A: Get 3 in a row on the 3 by 3 board, or 4 in a row on bigger boards, before your opponent does.

Q: Can I choose the board size and opponent?
A: Yes. Pick a board size and an opponent before you start.

Q: Can the hard computer be beaten on 3 by 3?
A: No. Hard mode on 3 by 3 never loses, so a draw is the best result against it.

### Glow Chain (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/glow-chain/)
Glow Chain is a memory game of lights and sounds. Press Start, watch the pattern, then repeat it by tapping the pads or pressing keys 1 to 4 (1 to 6 on Hard). One step is added every round, and in Normal and Hard one mistake ends the game.

Q: How do I play Glow Chain?
A: Press Start, watch the lights, then repeat the same pattern by tapping the pads or using the number keys.

Q: When does the game end?
A: In Normal and Hard modes a single mistake ends the game.

Q: When does sound start?
A: Sound starts only after you press Start.

### Mole Mallet (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/mole-mallet/)
Mole Mallet tests your reflexes. Pick a level, read its target score and tap each mole as it pops up. Golden moles are worth 3 points, and you must never tap a bomb. Hitting moles in a row raises your combo up to x3, and reaching the target unlocks the next level.

Q: How do I play Mole Mallet?
A: Tap each mole as it pops up. Golden moles are worth 3 and bombs must be avoided.

Q: What is the combo?
A: Hit moles in a row to raise the combo up to x3 and score more per hit.

Q: How do I unlock the next level?
A: Reach the target score shown for the level you are playing.

### Mine Radar (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/mine-radar/)
Mine Radar is a logic puzzle. Tap a square to dig; a number shows how many mines touch it. Press and hold, or use Flag mode, to mark a mine. When you have flagged as many mines as a number says, tap that number to open all its neighbours quickly.

Q: How do I play Mine Radar?
A: Tap a square to dig. A number shows how many of the eight surrounding squares hold mines.

Q: How do I place a flag on a phone?
A: Press and hold a square, or switch on Flag mode.

Q: What is the quick-open trick?
A: Tap a number after flagging that many mines around it, and all its other neighbours open at once.

### Sky Hop (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/sky-hop/)
Sky Hop is a one-tap flying game. Tap, click or press Space to hop and fly through the gaps between the pillars. Each gap is one point, and reaching 10, 25, 40 and 60 points earns bronze, silver, gold and platinum medals.

Q: How do I play Sky Hop?
A: Tap, click or press Space to hop, and steer through the gap between each pair of pillars.

Q: How do I earn medals?

Q: Is the score saved?
A: Your best score is saved in your own browser.

### Sliding Puzzle (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/sliding-puzzle/)

Q: How do I play the Sliding Puzzle?
A: Tap a tile in the same row or column as the empty gap to slide it, and arrange the tiles in order.

Q: Can I see the goal?

Q: Is my best score saved?
A: Yes, your best number of moves for each size is saved in your browser.

### Teer Nikalo (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/teer-nikalo/)
Teer Nikalo is a free puzzle game with three puzzles in one: Arrows, Ants and Screws. In the arrow puzzle every arrow leaves in the direction its tip points, and it only gets out if the path to the board edge is clear; otherwise it collides and you lose a heart. Clear the board before time runs out.

Q: How do I play the arrow puzzle?
A: Tap an arrow. It exits in the direction of its tip if the path to the edge is free. If another arrow blocks it, there is a collision and you lose a heart.

Q: What are the other puzzles?
A: Ant Sort moves ants between branches until each branch holds 4 ants of one colour, and in the Screw puzzle you unscrew only screws with no plate on top, sending each to its colour box or to the tray, which loses the level when full.

Q: Is progress saved?

### Parking Ustad (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/parking-ustad/)
Parking Ustad is a car parking puzzle. Tap a car and it drives out in the direction of its arrow, but only if the whole lane is clear; a car standing far away still blocks the road. Colliding costs a heart, and finishing a level with no collisions earns 3 stars. Hint, show-direction and remove boosters can help.

Q: How do I play Parking Ustad?
A: Tap a car. It leaves in its arrow direction only if the whole lane ahead is clear, so plan the order.

Q: How do I get 3 stars?
A: Clear the level without a single collision.

Q: What do the boosters do?
A: Hint suggests a move, Show direction reveals car directions and Remove takes a car off the board.

### Bus Bharo (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/bus-bharo/)
Bus Bharo is a queue-and-parking puzzle. Look at the passenger at the front of the line and send out a bus of the same colour. Parked buses take up limited spots, and the level fails if every spot is full and the front passenger matches none of the parked buses.

Q: How do I play Bus Bharo?
A: Check the colour of the passenger at the front of the queue and send a bus of that colour.

Q: When do I lose?
A: When all parking spots are full and the front passenger does not match any waiting bus.

Q: Can I get extra space?
A: Yes. You can buy an extra spot with coins.

### Gulal Pop (https://vidnexastudio.com/games/gulal-pop/)
Gulal Pop is a colourful rangoli puzzle for the festival of colours. Tap a bowl and it rides the belt, blasting open the pixels of its own colour in the rangoli. Waiting spots are limited, and every finished rangoli is added to your collection.

A: Tap a bowl. It travels around the belt and clears the open pixels of its colour from the rangoli.
