## Guides

### How to Calculate EMI: Formula, Example and Ways to Reduce It (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-calculate-emi/)
EMI stands for equated monthly instalment. It is the fixed amount you pay to the lender every month until a home loan, car loan or personal loan is fully repaid. Each EMI contains two parts: interest on the outstanding balance and a repayment of the principal. Knowing how it is calculated helps you compare loans before you sign.

#### The EMI formula
EMI = P × r × (1 + r)^n ÷ ((1 + r)^n − 1)
- P is the loan amount (principal).
- r is the monthly interest rate, which is the yearly rate divided by 12 and by 100.
- n is the number of monthly instalments.

#### A worked example
Take a loan of ₹5,00,000 at 10% a year for 5 years. The monthly rate r is 10 ÷ 12 ÷ 100 = 0.008333 and n is 60. Putting these in the formula gives an EMI of about ₹10,624. Over 60 months you pay roughly ₹6,37,400 in total, so the interest is about ₹1,37,400. You can check this in seconds with the EMI Calculator.

#### Why the first EMIs are mostly interest
Interest is charged on the balance still owed. At the start the balance is large, so most of the EMI goes to interest. As the balance falls, a bigger share goes to principal. This is why the yearly schedule in the calculator shows the balance falling slowly at first and faster later.

#### How to lower your EMI or total interest
- Choose a longer tenure to lower the monthly EMI, but remember that total interest rises.
- Make a larger down payment so the principal is smaller.
- Compare interest rates and processing fees from several lenders.
- Part-prepay when you have spare money. Check first whether your lender charges a prepayment fee.
- Keep a good credit score, since it can help you get a lower rate.

#### Fixed and floating rates
With a fixed rate the EMI stays the same. With a floating rate the lender can change the rate, so your EMI or your tenure can change. The calculator assumes one fixed rate for the whole loan, so treat the result as a close estimate.
This article is for general information and is not financial advice. Check the final figures in your loan agreement.

Q: Is a lower EMI always better?
A: Not always. A lower EMI usually comes from a longer tenure, which means you pay more interest overall.

Q: Does the EMI Calculator include processing fees?
A: No. It uses only the principal, rate and tenure, so add fees and insurance yourself when comparing offers.

### How a SIP Works: Compounding Explained Simply (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-sip-works-and-compounding/)
A systematic investment plan, or SIP, lets you invest a fixed amount at regular intervals, usually every month, in a mutual fund. Instead of trying to pick the perfect day to invest, you invest steadily. Over time the money you invest and the returns on it can grow through compounding.

#### What compounding means
Compounding means you earn returns on your earlier returns as well as on the money you put in. If you invest ₹5,000 a month and the investment grows at an assumed 12% a year, the growth in later years is applied to a larger and larger base. That is why the same SIP looks much bigger after 20 years than twice the value after 10 years.

#### How the SIP Calculator works
You enter the monthly amount, an expected yearly return and the number of years. The tool treats each monthly instalment as growing for the remaining months and adds them up. It then shows the total you invested, the estimated gain and the final value. The calculator is only an illustration of the maths.

#### What the calculator cannot tell you
- Market-linked returns rise and fall. No return is guaranteed.
- Actual returns will not be the same every year as the calculator assumes.
- Costs, taxes and inflation reduce what you finally keep and what it can buy.

#### Sensible ways to use it
- Try a cautious return rate as well as an optimistic one.
- Compare the same monthly amount for 10, 15 and 20 years to see how time matters.
- Try increasing the SIP a little every year, a step-up, to see how it speeds up your goal.
- Match the investment period to your goal. Money needed soon should not usually sit in risky investments.
This article is for general education and is not investment advice. Speak to a qualified adviser before investing.

Q: Is the SIP result guaranteed?
A: No. It only shows what would happen if the entered return were earned every year.

Q: Is it better to start early?
A: Starting early gives compounding more time to work, which usually matters more than the exact return rate.

### How GST Works: How to Add or Remove GST From a Price (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-gst-works-add-and-remove-gst/)
Goods and Services Tax, or GST, is the indirect tax charged on most goods and services in India. Shops, freelancers and small businesses often need to add GST to a price or work out how much GST is hidden inside a price that already includes it.

#### CGST, SGST and IGST
- When a sale is within one state, the GST is split into CGST (for the central government) and SGST (for the state). At 18% GST each half is 9%.
- When a sale is between two states, IGST is charged as a single tax at the full rate.
- The rate depends on the goods or service. Common slabs include 5%, 12%, 18% and 28%, and rates are revised from time to time, so always confirm the current rate.

#### How to add GST
GST amount = price × rate ÷ 100. Final price = price + GST. For a ₹1,000 item at 18%, GST is ₹180 and the final price is ₹1,180.

#### How to remove GST from an inclusive price
Net price = inclusive price ÷ (1 + rate ÷ 100). For ₹1,180 at 18%, the net price is 1,180 ÷ 1.18 = ₹1,000, and the GST inside it is ₹180. A common mistake is to take 18% off ₹1,180, which gives the wrong answer.

#### Using the GST Calculator
1. Enter the amount.
2. Choose the GST rate.
3. Pick add GST or remove GST.
4. Read the net price, the GST and the CGST and SGST split.
For invoices, the correct rate and place of supply matter, so confirm them with the official GST rate list or an accountant. This article is general information, not tax advice.

Q: Why is removing GST not the same as subtracting 18%?
A: Because GST was added on top of the net price. You must divide by 1.18, not subtract 18% of the total.

Q: Which GST rate applies to my product?
A: It depends on the item or service. Check the official GST notifications or ask an accountant.

### How to Calculate Percentage: 3 Easy Methods With Examples (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-calculate-percentage/)
A percentage is a number out of 100. Percentages are used for marks, discounts, interest, tax, tips and growth. Three types of question cover almost every case.

#### 1. Find X% of a number
Multiply the number by X and divide by 100. Example: 15% of 200 = 200 × 15 ÷ 100 = 30.

#### 2. Find what percent one number is of another
Divide the part by the whole and multiply by 100. Example: if you scored 42 out of 60, then 42 ÷ 60 × 100 = 70%.

#### 3. Find percentage increase or decrease
Subtract the old value from the new value, divide by the old value and multiply by 100. Example: a price rising from 80 to 100 is (100 − 80) ÷ 80 × 100 = 25% increase. A drop from 100 to 80 is a 20% decrease, not 25%, because the base is different.

#### Common mistakes
- Dividing by the new value instead of the old value when finding change.
- Thinking a 50% rise followed by a 50% fall returns to the start. It does not: 100 becomes 150, then 75.
- Adding two discounts together. 20% off then 10% off equals 28% off, not 30%.

#### Use the Percentage Calculator
Choose the question type, type the numbers and the tool gives the answer with the formula, which is useful for checking homework or a quick price decision.

Q: How do I turn a fraction into a percentage?
A: Divide the top by the bottom and multiply by 100. For example 3/4 = 0.75 = 75%.

Q: What is the difference between percentage and percentage points?
A: If a rate goes from 10% to 12%, it rises by 2 percentage points, which is a 20% increase in the rate.

### How to Calculate Age and the Days Between Two Dates (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-calculate-age-and-days-between-dates/)
Forms, exams, insurance and job applications often ask for your exact age on a certain date. Project plans and notice periods need the number of days between two dates. Doing it by hand is easy to get wrong because months have different lengths and leap years add an extra day.

#### How age is calculated
1. Subtract the birth year from the target year.
2. If the birthday has not yet come in the target year, subtract one year.
3. Count the remaining months and days from the last birthday to the target date.
For example, from 15 August 2000 to 4 November 2026 is 26 years, 2 months and 20 days.

#### Why leap years matter
A leap year has 366 days because February has 29. A person born on 29 February has a birthday only every four years, and calculators usually treat the day after 28 February as their birthday in other years.

#### Counting days between dates
Computers convert both dates to a day count and subtract them. Decide whether to include the end date: from 1 to 10 of a month is 9 days apart, or 10 days if both the first and last day count. The Date Difference Calculator has an option for this.

#### Useful uses
- Checking minimum or maximum age for an exam or job.
- Counting the days left to a deadline, trip or event.
- Working out a notice period or the days since a start date.
Calendar days include weekends and holidays. If you need working days only, subtract them separately.

Q: Does the age calculator work for future dates?
A: Yes. Enter any date in the age-at field to see how old someone will be on that date.

Q: What if my form counts age on a fixed date?
A: Many forms use a cut-off date such as 1 January. Enter that date as the age-at date.

### What Is BMI? How It Is Calculated and What It Can and Cannot Tell You (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/what-is-bmi-and-how-to-use-it/)
BMI, or body mass index, is a number that relates your weight to your height. Doctors use it as a quick screening tool. It is simple to calculate but it has clear limits, so it should never be the only thing you look at.

#### The formula
BMI = weight in kilograms ÷ (height in metres)². A person who weighs 70 kg and is 1.75 m tall has a BMI of 70 ÷ 3.0625 = 22.9.

#### The standard ranges for adults
- Below 18.5: underweight
- 18.5 to 24.9: normal range
- 25 to 29.9: overweight
- 30 and above: obese
Some health guidelines for South Asian adults use lower cut-offs for overweight and obesity because health risks can rise at a lower BMI. A doctor can tell you which guidance applies to you.

#### What BMI cannot show
- It does not separate muscle from fat, so a muscular person may show a high BMI.
- It does not show where fat is stored on the body.
- It does not account for age, sex or medical conditions in the simple formula.
- It is not a diagnosis.

#### Using the BMI Calculator
Enter your height and weight in the units you prefer. The tool shows your BMI, the range it falls in and a weight range that matches the normal BMI band for your height. Use it as a starting point for a conversation with a doctor or dietitian.
This article is general information and not medical advice.

Q: Is BMI accurate for athletes?
A: Not always. Muscle weighs more than fat, so athletes can have a high BMI without excess body fat.

Q: Can children use the same BMI ranges?
A: No. Children's BMI is compared with charts for age and sex, so ask a paediatrician.

### How to Compress Images Without Losing Quality (Free, in Your Browser) (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-compress-images-without-losing-quality/)
Large photos slow websites, fill storage and fail upload limits on forms. Compression makes the file smaller. Done well, you will not notice any difference on screen.

#### How compression works
JPG and WebP use lossy compression. They throw away fine detail that the human eye hardly notices, such as tiny colour differences. The lower the quality setting, the more detail is discarded and the smaller the file becomes. PNG uses lossless compression, which keeps every pixel but gives smaller savings on photos.

#### Steps to compress an image
1. Open the Image Compressor and choose your photos.
2. Set the quality. Around 70 to 80 percent is a good starting point.
3. Compare the sizes shown for the original and compressed versions.
4. Download the new files.

#### Get even smaller files
- Resize first. A 4000 pixel wide photo is far larger than a web page needs. Use the Image Resizer to bring it down to 1200 to 1600 pixels.
- Choose WebP for websites. It is usually smaller than JPG at similar quality.
- Use JPG for photos and PNG for logos or screenshots with sharp text.

#### Why browser-based compression is private
The tool runs inside your browser. Your photos are never uploaded to a server, which matters for ID cards, documents and family pictures.

#### Does compression harm quality?
At moderate settings the loss is rarely visible. Very low settings create blocky patches and blurry edges, so check the preview before saving. Always keep your original file.

Q: What quality should I choose for a website?
A: Between 70 and 80 percent works for most photos. Check the preview if the picture has fine details.

Q: Can I compress a PNG?
A: PNG is lossless, so savings are small. Converting a photo from PNG to JPG or WebP usually saves much more.

### PNG vs JPG vs WebP: Which Image Format Should You Use? (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/png-vs-jpg-vs-webp/)
Choosing the wrong image format can make a file too large or blur sharp text. Here is a quick guide to the three most common formats on the web.

#### JPG (JPEG)
Best for photographs. It uses lossy compression to make small files and works everywhere. It does not support transparency, and repeated saving lowers quality.

#### PNG
Best for logos, icons, screenshots and anything with sharp edges or text. It is lossless and supports transparent backgrounds. Photos saved as PNG can be very large.

#### WebP
A modern format that supports both lossy and lossless compression and transparency. WebP files are usually smaller than JPG or PNG at similar quality, which helps pages load faster. All current major browsers can display it, though some older software cannot open it.

#### Quick choice table
- Photo for a website: WebP, or JPG if you need maximum compatibility.
- Logo with transparent background: PNG or WebP.
- Screenshot with text: PNG.
- Photo for a government form or email: JPG.

#### How to convert
1. Open the Image Converter.
2. Choose your image.
3. Pick PNG, JPG or WebP as the output.
4. Download the converted file.
When you convert a transparent PNG to JPG, the transparent area becomes a solid colour because JPG cannot store transparency. The conversion happens in your browser, so your image is not uploaded.

Q: Is WebP better than JPG?
A: Usually smaller at similar quality, but JPG is more widely supported in older software.

Q: Why did my transparent logo get a white background?
A: JPG cannot store transparency, so the empty area is filled with a solid colour. Keep the logo as PNG or WebP.

### How to Merge and Split PDF Files for Free Without Uploading Them (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-merge-and-split-pdf-files/)
Job applications, loan papers, college forms and invoices often need several documents in one PDF, or just a few pages from a long one. You can do both in your browser, without installing software and without sending the files to a server.

#### How to merge PDFs

3. Drag them into the order you need.
4. Press merge and download the single combined PDF.

#### How to split a PDF or extract pages
1. Open the PDF Split tool and choose your file.
2. Type the pages you want, for example 1-3, 7, 10-12.
3. Download the new PDF that contains only those pages.

#### How to turn images into a PDF
Use the Image to PDF tool. Select your photos or scans, arrange the order, choose the page size and create the PDF. This is handy for ID copies, bills and handwritten notes you photographed.

#### Tips for a smooth result
- Check the page order before you merge.
- Remove the password of protected PDFs first, as they may not merge.
- Compress large photos before putting them in a PDF to keep it small for email and online forms.
- Keep the original files until you have checked the final PDF.

#### Is it private?
Yes. The tools work with a PDF library running in your browser, so your documents stay on your device. This is useful for sensitive papers such as bank statements and IDs.

Q: Can I merge a PDF with images?
A: Convert the images to a PDF first using Image to PDF, then merge that PDF with the others.

Q: Why will my PDF not merge?
A: It may be password protected or damaged. Remove the password in a PDF reader and try again.

### How to Clean Up Text: Remove Duplicates, Sort Lines and Fix Capitalisation (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-clean-up-text-lists/)
Messy lists waste time. Whether it is an email list, a set of keywords or a column copied from a spreadsheet, a few simple steps can make it clean.

#### Step 1: remove duplicates
Paste your list into the Remove Duplicate Lines tool. It keeps the first copy of each line and deletes the repeats. Turn on case-insensitive matching if you want Apple and apple treated as the same item.

#### Step 2: sort the list
Use the Text Sorter to arrange lines A to Z, Z to A or by length. Sorting makes it easy to spot near-duplicates and to find an item quickly. There is also a shuffle mode for random draws and team lists.

#### Step 3: fix capitalisation
The Case Converter changes text to UPPERCASE, lowercase, Title Case or Sentence case. It is perfect for text typed with Caps Lock on. For developers it can also produce camelCase and snake_case names.

#### Step 4: make clean web addresses
The Slug Generator turns a title into a short, lowercase, hyphen-separated slug. Short slugs that contain the main keyword are easier to read in search results and links.

#### Why do it in the browser?
These tools run on your device. Customer lists and private notes are not uploaded, which is safer than pasting them into unknown websites.

#### A quick workflow
1. Paste the raw list.
2. Remove duplicates.
3. Sort A to Z.
4. Fix the case.
5. Copy the result back to your document.

Q: Does removing duplicates change the order?
A: No. It keeps the first occurrence and the original order of the remaining lines.

Q: What is a slug?
A: A slug is the readable last part of a web address, such as how-to-merge-pdf.

### How to Improve Your Typing Speed: Practical Tips and a Free Test (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-improve-typing-speed/)
Typing faster saves time every day, for studying, writing and office work. Speed comes from accuracy and good habits, not from rushing.

#### How WPM is measured
Typing tests count every five characters, including spaces, as one word. Words per minute is that word count divided by the time taken. Accuracy is the share of characters you typed correctly. A fast score with many mistakes is not useful, so look at both numbers.

#### What is a good speed?
- Around 35 to 45 WPM is typical for most people.
- Above 60 WPM is fast for office work.
- 70 WPM and above is common for professional typists.

#### Habits that help
1. Learn touch typing: keep your fingers on the home row and avoid looking at the keys.
2. Prioritise accuracy. Slow down until mistakes are rare, then build speed.
3. Practise 10 to 15 minutes every day rather than one long session a week.
4. Sit upright with relaxed shoulders and wrists to avoid strain.
5. Take the Typing Speed Test regularly and track your progress.

#### Using the Word Counter for writing practice
After a typing session, paste your writing into the Word Counter to see words, characters and reading time. Setting a daily word target is a good way to build the habit.
Progress is usually steady: many learners add 5 to 10 WPM in the first few weeks of regular practice, though results differ from person to person.

Q: Does a bigger keyboard or phone change my WPM?
A: Yes. Phone typing is usually slower than a physical keyboard, so compare scores on the same device.

Q: How often should I practise?
A: A short daily session is more effective than occasional long ones.

### How Browser-Based Tools Work (And Why Your Files Stay Private) (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-browser-based-tools-work-without-uploading/)
Most online tools ask you to upload a file to a server. The tools on Vidnexa Studio work differently: they run inside your browser, on your own phone or computer. Here is how that works and why it matters.

#### Your browser is a small computer program platform
Modern browsers can run JavaScript, draw on a canvas, record audio and video, read files you choose and decode images. A tool page simply ships a small program to your browser. When you choose a file, the program reads it from your device, changes it and gives you the result to download. The file never has to travel over the internet.

#### Examples
- The Image Compressor draws your photo on a canvas and saves it again at lower quality.
- PDF Merge and PDF Split use a PDF library that runs in your browser.
- Video tools replay the video and re-record it with the browser's recorder.
- Text tools such as the Word Counter simply read the text box.

#### Why it is better for privacy
- Your ID cards, bank statements and family photos are not sent to a third party.
- There is no waiting for a slow upload or download.
- Tools keep working even on a weak connection after the page has loaded.

#### How to check it yourself
Open the tool, switch your phone to flight mode or turn off Wi-Fi, then use it. A browser-based tool still works because it does not need the internet to process your file. You can also look at the network tab of your browser developer tools and see that no file upload happens.

#### Limits to know
- Very large files depend on your device memory.
- Video is processed in real time, so it takes as long as the video itself.
- Features such as screen recording need browser support and your permission.
See the Privacy Policy for what the site itself collects, such as standard visit statistics and ads.

Q: Can I use the tools offline?
A: After a tool page has loaded, most tools keep working without a connection, because processing happens on your device.

Q: Do you keep a copy of my files?
A: No. Files you choose in a tool are processed in your browser and are not uploaded to our servers.

### How QR Codes Work and How to Make One for Free (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-qr-codes-work-and-how-to-make-one/)
A QR code is a square pattern of dark and light modules that stores data such as a web link, a message or Wi-Fi details. Your phone camera reads the pattern and turns it back into the data.

#### How a QR code is built
- Three large squares in the corners tell the camera where the code is and which way it faces.
- The remaining modules store the data in a pattern.
- Extra error-correction data lets the code still scan if part of it is dirty or covered.

#### How to make a QR code
1. Open the QR Code Generator.
2. Choose what to encode: a link, plain text or Wi-Fi details.
3. Type the information. For Wi-Fi, enter the network name, password and security type.
4. Download the code as an image.

#### Do QR codes expire?
Codes made by this tool hold the data directly, so they do not expire. If the code points to a link, it works as long as that link works. Be careful with services that charge to keep codes working.

#### Tips for printing
- Use dark code on a light background with good contrast.
- Leave a clear blank margin around the code.
- Print at least 2 cm wide for close scanning and larger for posters.
- Test the printed code with two or three phones before printing many copies.
- Shorter links make simpler, easier-to-scan codes.

#### Staying safe
Only scan codes from sources you trust, because a code can lead to any web address. Look at the link your phone shows before you open it.

Q: What can a QR code store?
A: Links, plain text, contact details, Wi-Fi details and more. This tool supports links, text and Wi-Fi.

Q: Why will my QR code not scan?
A: Usually low contrast, too small a print size, or a missing blank border. Make it larger and use dark on light.

### How to Create a Strong Password (and How a Generator Helps) (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-create-a-strong-password/)
Weak passwords are a leading cause of hacked accounts. A strong password is long, random and used for only one account.

#### What makes a password strong
- Length. Each extra character multiplies the number of guesses needed. Aim for at least 14 characters for important accounts.
- Randomness. Names, birthdays and words like password123 are the first things attackers try.
- Uniqueness. If one site leaks your password, attackers try it everywhere else.

#### How the Password Generator works
It uses your browser's cryptographic random generator, which is designed for security, unlike the simple generator used for games. You choose the length and which characters to include, and the password is created on your device. It is not sent anywhere or stored.

#### Steps
1. Open the Password Generator and set the length to 14 or more.
2. Include letters, numbers and symbols if the site allows them.
3. Copy the password straight into your password manager or the site.
4. Never reuse it on another account.

#### Remember all those passwords
Nobody can remember dozens of random passwords. Use a trusted password manager and protect it with one strong passphrase, which is a string of several random words.

#### Extra protection
- Turn on two-factor authentication wherever it is offered.
- Be careful about phishing messages that ask for your password.
- Change a password at once if a service reports a data breach.

#### A note about hashes
Sites should store a hash of your password, not the password itself. The Hash Generator shows what hashes look like, but plain SHA hashes are not suitable for storing passwords. Real systems use slow methods such as bcrypt or Argon2.

Q: Is it safe to use an online password generator?
A: It is safe when the password is generated in your browser and never sent anywhere, as with this tool.

Q: How long should my password be?
A: At least 12 characters, and 14 or more for email, banking and other important accounts.

### What Is JSON? How to Format It and Fix Common Errors (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/what-is-json-and-how-to-fix-json-errors/)
JSON, or JavaScript Object Notation, is a simple text format for storing and sending data. APIs, settings files and apps use it everywhere. It is easy to read but unforgiving: one wrong comma and the whole file fails.

#### What JSON looks like
Data is written as keys and values inside curly braces, with lists inside square brackets. For example: {"name": "Asha", "age": 25, "skills": ["design", "code"]}.

#### The most common JSON errors
- A trailing comma after the last item.
- Single quotes instead of double quotes around keys and text.
- Unquoted keys.
- Missing commas between items or a missing closing bracket.
- Comments, which JSON does not allow.

#### How to use the JSON Formatter
1. Paste your JSON into the box.
2. Press Format to add neat indentation, or Minify to remove extra spaces.
3. Press Validate. If the JSON is wrong you see a message and the position of the problem.
4. Fix the problem and format again.

#### Format or minify?
Formatted JSON is easier for people to read. Minified JSON removes spaces and line breaks, which makes the data a little smaller to send. Use formatted JSON while working and minified JSON when sending data.

#### Keep sensitive data safe
The tool parses your JSON in your browser. Even so, avoid pasting live passwords or secret keys into any website.

Q: Why does my JSON say unexpected token?
A: There is usually a stray character, a missing comma or a trailing comma near the position shown in the error.

Q: Can JSON have comments?
A: No. Remove comments, or use a format designed for config files that allows them.

### Base64 and URL Encoding Explained With Simple Examples (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/base64-and-url-encoding-explained/)
Computers often need to send data through systems that only handle plain text. Base64 and URL encoding are two ways of making data safe for those systems.

#### What is Base64?
Base64 represents any data using 64 safe characters: letters, numbers, plus and slash. It is used to put images in HTML or CSS, send attachments by email and carry data in JSON. Base64 makes data about one third larger, and it is not encryption. Anyone can decode it.

#### What is URL encoding?
Web addresses can only contain certain characters. Others, such as spaces, ampersands and non-English letters, are replaced by a percent sign and two digits. A space becomes %20, so "cake recipe" becomes cake%20recipe.

#### When to use which
- Use URL encoding for text inside a link or query string.
- Use Base64 to carry binary data, such as a small image, as text.
- Never use either one to hide a password.

#### How to use the tools
1. Open the Base64 Encoder Decoder, paste text and choose encode or decode.
2. Open the URL Encoder Decoder to make text safe for a link or to read a messy encoded link.
3. Open Image to Base64 to turn a small image into a data URI you can paste into code.

#### Common problems
- Decoding fails if characters were lost when copying.
- Encoding a whole URL, instead of only its values, can break it.
- Plus signs in query strings may mean a space in some systems.

Q: Is Base64 a type of encryption?
A: No. It is just a way of writing data as text and anyone can reverse it.

Q: Why is %20 in my link?
A: It is the encoded form of a space character.

### Unix Timestamps and UUIDs Explained for Beginners (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-unix-timestamps-and-uuids-work/)
Developers use two kinds of identifiers all the time: timestamps, to record when something happened, and UUIDs, to give things unique names.

#### What is a Unix timestamp?
A Unix timestamp is the number of seconds that have passed since 1 January 1970 at 00:00 UTC. It is one simple number that every computer in the world can compare, whatever the time zone. A 10-digit value is usually in seconds and a 13-digit value is in milliseconds.

#### How to convert one
1. Open the Timestamp Converter.
2. Paste the number to see the date in your local time and in UTC.
3. Or pick a date to get its timestamp.

#### Good habits
- Store times as UTC timestamps and convert them to local time only for display.
- Check whether your system uses seconds or milliseconds.
- Remember that the same timestamp shows different clock times in different time zones.

#### What is a UUID?
A UUID is a 128-bit identifier written like 3f2b8c1e-9a4d-4e6f-8b21-5c7d9e0a1f34. Version 4 UUIDs are made from random numbers. The chance of two being the same is so small that they are treated as unique, which is why databases and APIs use them as IDs without checking with a central server.

#### Using the UUID Generator
Choose how many you need and copy them. Use them as record IDs, test data or request IDs. A UUID is an identifier, not a secret, so do not use it as a password.

Q: Why does a timestamp start in 1970?
A: It is a convention chosen by early Unix systems, called the Unix epoch.

Q: Can two UUIDs ever match?
A: In theory yes, but the probability is so tiny it is ignored in practice.

### How to Compress, Trim and Change Video Speed in Your Browser (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-compress-trim-and-speed-up-videos-in-browser/)
Sharing a big video on WhatsApp or a form with an upload limit is a common problem. Three simple edits fix most cases: trim it, compress it and, if you like, change the speed.

#### How browser video editing works
The browser plays your video and re-records it as a new file while it applies the change, for example a smaller size or a different speed. Because this happens in real time on your device, a 2 minute video takes about 2 minutes. Nothing is uploaded.

#### Step 1: check the video
Use Video Info to see the resolution, duration, size and bitrate. A 1080p video of a few minutes can be hundreds of megabytes.

#### Step 2: trim it
Open the Video Trimmer, choose the start and end points and preview the section. Cutting unneeded seconds reduces size immediately.

#### Step 3: compress it
Open the Video Compressor and choose a lower resolution or quality. Reducing resolution, for example from 1080p to 720p, saves the most space and is usually fine for phones.

#### Optional: change the speed
The Video Speed Changer can slow a clip down to 0.25x for slow motion or speed it up to 4x for a time-lapse effect. Sound speeds up or slows down with the picture.

#### Tips
- Keep the browser tab open and visible until the file is ready.
- Test with a short clip to find the best settings.
- Trim first, then compress.
- Use a desktop browser such as Chrome or Edge for the best results.
- Only edit videos you own or have permission to use.

Q: Why does compressing take as long as the video?
A: The browser records the video again in real time, so processing time is about the length of the video.

Q: Which output format do I get?
A: It depends on your browser, usually WebM or MP4.

### How to Make a GIF, Extract Audio and Save Frames From a Video (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-make-gif-extract-audio-and-save-video-frames/)
Sometimes you need only part of a video: a funny moment as a GIF, a song or lecture as audio, or one perfect frame as a picture. These tools do it in your browser without uploading the video.

#### Make a GIF from a video
1. Open Video to GIF and choose your video.
2. Pick the start time and a length of a few seconds.
3. Choose the width and frame rate. 480 pixels wide and 10 to 12 frames per second is a good balance.

GIFs store every frame as an image, so they become large quickly. Short clips and smaller sizes keep the file easy to share. GIFs do not carry sound.

#### Extract the audio
Video to Audio pulls the sound track out of a video and saves it as a WAV file. WAV is uncompressed, so the file is large, but quality is full. Convert it to MP3 later if you need a smaller file. Only extract audio from videos you own or have the right to use.

#### Save a frame as an image
1. Open the Video Frame Extractor and load the video.
2. Move to the exact moment, using the step buttons for precision.
3. Save the frame as PNG for best quality or JPG for a smaller file.
The picture has the same resolution as the video, so a Full HD video gives a 1920 by 1080 image.

#### Tips
- Pause on a sharp moment, as motion can blur a frame.
- Trim long videos first if you only need a section.
- Keep the tab open until processing is finished.

Q: Why is my GIF file so big?
A: Shorten the clip, make it narrower or lower the frame rate.

Q: Can I get MP3 audio?
A: The tool saves WAV. Use an audio app to convert it to MP3 if needed.

### How to Record Your Screen and Your Voice Online (No Software) (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-record-your-screen-and-voice-online/)
Tutorials, bug reports, online classes and voice notes all start with a recording. Modern browsers can record your screen and microphone directly, with your permission, so you do not need extra software.

#### How to record your screen
1. Open the Screen Recorder on a desktop browser such as Chrome or Edge.
2. Press start and choose what to share: the whole screen, one window or one browser tab.
3. Optionally allow audio, for example tab audio or your microphone.
4. Press stop and download the video.
Most mobile browsers do not allow screen capture from a web page. On a phone, use the screen recorder built into your phone instead.

#### How to record your voice
1. Open the Voice Recorder and allow microphone access.
2. Press record and speak.
3. Stop, listen back and download the recording.

#### Tips for clearer recordings
- Record in a quiet room and keep the microphone close.
- Use headphones so the speakers do not cause echo.
- Make a 10 second test first to check levels.
- Close private tabs and mute notifications before sharing a screen.

#### Privacy
The browser asks for your permission each time. The recording is made on your device and is not uploaded. It is lost when you close the page unless you download it, so save it before leaving.
Only record people, calls or screens when you have the right to do so.

Q: Why can I not record my screen on my phone browser?
A: Mobile browsers generally do not support screen capture for web pages. Use the phone's built-in recorder.

Q: Is my recording stored online?
A: No. It stays on your device.

### How to Play 2048: Rules, Tips and a Winning Strategy (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-2048-tips-and-strategy/)
2048 is a sliding puzzle played on a four by four grid of numbered tiles. It is easy to learn and surprisingly deep.

#### The rules
1. Swipe or use the arrow keys to slide every tile in one direction.
2. When two tiles with the same number touch, they merge into one tile with double the value.
3. After every move a new tile appears.
4. Reach the 2048 tile to win. You can keep playing for a higher score.
5. The game ends when the board is full and no merge is possible. Use Undo, or press Z, if you slip.

#### Strategy that works
- Keep your biggest tile in one corner and never move it out. Choose a corner and mostly use only two directions, for example down and left.
- Build a chain of tiles in descending order along one edge, so merges ripple along it.
- Avoid pressing the direction that would move your corner tile away from the corner. If you must, plan to return it at once.
- Keep the board tidy. Merge small tiles early rather than letting many different numbers fill the grid.
- Think two moves ahead instead of making a move for a quick merge.

#### Why people enjoy it
The game rewards planning and patience. A session can last a minute or an hour, which makes it easy to play in short breaks. It is a good exercise in thinking ahead, and a session is just entertainment.
Your best score is saved in your own browser. Try the game on Vidnexa Studio, free and with no sign-up.

Q: What is the highest tile in 2048?
A: The game continues beyond 2048. In theory the largest possible tile on a 4 by 4 board is 131072.

Q: Is 2048 luck or skill?
A: Both, but strategy matters a lot. Corner play greatly improves your results.

### How to Play Snake: Modes, Controls and Tips for a High Score (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-snake-modes-and-tips/)
Snake is one of the oldest and most loved arcade games. You guide a snake around the board, eat apples to grow and avoid crashing.

#### Controls
- On a keyboard, use the arrow keys or WASD.
- On a phone or tablet, swipe on the board in the direction you want to go.

#### The three modes
- Classic: the walls are deadly, so hitting an edge ends the game.
- Wrap-around: the snake can pass through one edge and come out on the opposite side.
- Rocks: obstacles appear as you grow, so you must plan routes around them.

#### Scoring
Each apple adds to your score and makes the snake longer. A golden star is worth 3 points but disappears quickly, so take it only when the route is safe.

#### Tips
1. Plan your path a few steps ahead, especially as the snake grows.
2. Use the edges and make long loops so you keep open space in the middle.
3. Do not chase every golden star. A safe route is worth more than 3 points.
4. In Wrap-around mode, remember that you can turn at an edge instead of stopping.
5. Stay calm. Panicky quick turns usually lead to crashing into your own tail.
Your best score is saved in your own browser. Play Snake free on Vidnexa Studio.

Q: Can I play Snake on my phone?
A: Yes. Swipe on the board to steer.

Q: Which mode is the easiest?
A: Wrap-around is usually the most forgiving because the edges are not deadly.

### How to Play Mine Radar: Rules, Flags and Strategy for Beginners (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-mine-radar-rules-and-tips/)
Mine Radar is a logic puzzle: clear a grid of squares without digging up a hidden mine. No luck is needed once you learn to read the numbers.

#### The basics
1. Tap a square to dig it.
2. A number shows how many of the eight surrounding squares contain mines.
3. A blank square means no mines are adjacent, and the game opens its neighbours for you.
4. Mark squares you believe are mines with a flag, by pressing and holding or by using Flag mode.
5. Clear every safe square to win.

#### The quick-open trick
When you have flagged exactly as many mines around a number as the number says, tap that number. All its other neighbours open at once. It saves many taps, but a wrong flag will make you hit a mine, so be careful.

#### Simple logic patterns
- If a number equals the count of unopened squares next to it, all of them are mines.
- If a number already has all its mines flagged, the other neighbours are safe.
- Corners and edges have fewer neighbours, so start there when you can.

#### Tips
- Start on the easiest level and learn the patterns.
- Flag only mines you are sure about.
- If you are stuck, look for a different area of the board instead of guessing.
Mine Radar is free to play on Vidnexa Studio in your browser.

Q: How do I flag a square on a phone?
A: Press and hold the square, or turn on Flag mode.

Q: Is the first tap safe?
A: In most versions the first tap is safe. Check the rules shown in the game.

### Memory and Reflex Games: How to Play Memory Match, Glow Chain, Mole Mallet and Sky Hop (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/memory-and-reflex-games-guide/)
Short games that test memory and reaction time are fun breaks, and each has a few simple tricks.

#### Memory Match
Flip two cards at a time and find every pair. Fewer moves earn more stars, and levels 10 to 12 have a limited number of moves. Tip: remember the position of every card you flip, even when it is not a match, and work in one area of the grid at a time.

#### Glow Chain
Press Start and watch the lights, then repeat the pattern by tapping the pads or by pressing keys 1 to 4 (1 to 6 on Hard). One step is added every round. In Normal and Hard, one mistake ends the game. Tip: group the sequence into chunks of three and say the colours quietly to yourself.

#### Mole Mallet
Pick a level and read its target score. Tap each mole as it pops up. Golden moles are worth 3 and you must never tap a bomb. Hits in a row build a combo up to x3. Tip: keep your eyes on the whole board, not one hole, and do not rush a tap on a bomb.

#### Sky Hop
Tap, click or press Space to hop through the gaps between pillars. Each gap is a point, and 10, 25, 40 and 60 points earn bronze, silver, gold and platinum medals. Tip: use short, steady taps and keep your rhythm.

#### Do such games help your brain?
Playing practises the specific game, and many people find it a relaxing way to focus. Research on whether casual games improve everyday memory or thinking is mixed, so enjoy them as entertainment and as a short mental break, not as a medical treatment. Regular sleep, exercise and learning new skills matter much more for brain health.

Q: Which of these games is best for memory practice?
A: Memory Match and Glow Chain both ask you to remember positions or sequences.

Q: Are these games free?
A: Yes. They run in your browser with no download or sign-up.

### How to Play Teer Nikalo, Parking Ustad, Bus Bharo and Gulal Pop (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-puzzle-games-teer-nikalo-parking-ustad-bus-bharo-gulal-pop/)
These four puzzles reward thinking before tapping. Here is how each one works.

#### Teer Nikalo
Teer Nikalo has three puzzles in one.
- Arrows: every arrow leaves in the direction its tip points. It gets out only if the path to the edge of the board is clear. If another arrow is in the way, there is a collision and you lose a heart. Clear the board before time runs out.
- Ants: tap one branch, then another, to move the ants. Put four ants of the same colour on each branch.
- Screws: only a screw with no plate on top can be opened. It goes to the box of its colour, or to the tray if there is no box. If the tray is full, you lose.

#### Parking Ustad
Tap a car and it drives out in the direction of its arrow, but only if the whole lane is clear. Even a car standing far away blocks the road. Finish a level without a single collision for 3 stars. Hint, Show direction and Remove boosters are there for hard levels.

#### Bus Bharo
Look at the passenger at the front of the queue and send out a bus of the same colour. Parking spots are limited. If all spots are full and the front passenger does not match any waiting bus, the level fails. You can buy one extra spot with coins.

#### Gulal Pop
Tap a bowl and it rides the belt, blasting open the pixels of its colour in the rangoli. Waiting spots are limited. Each finished rangoli is added to your collection.

#### Tips for all four
1. Look at the whole board before your first tap.
2. Start with the pieces that are already free and work towards the blocked ones.
3. Do not use boosters on early levels. Save them for hard ones.
4. If you get stuck, restart the level. A fresh plan often works better than undoing.
Progress and scores are saved in your own browser, so clearing your browser data resets them.

Q: Do I need to download these games?
A: No. They run in your browser.

Q: Are the boosters free?
A: Some boosters use coins you earn by playing. There is no payment needed.

### How to Win at Tic Tac Toe and Solve the Sliding Puzzle (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-tic-tac-toe-and-sliding-puzzle/)

#### Tic Tac Toe
Choose a board size and an opponent, then place your marks. On the 3 by 3 board you need 3 in a row, and on bigger boards you need 4 in a row. Hard mode on 3 by 3 never loses, so a draw is a good result against it.
- Take the centre if you can, or a corner if the centre is taken.
- Always check whether your opponent has two in a row and block the third.
- Create a fork: a move that gives you two ways to win at once.
- On bigger boards, build open lines with space on both ends.

#### Sliding Puzzle
Tap a tile in the same row or column as the gap to slide it. Put the tiles in order. Hold Peek to see the goal, and try to beat your best number of moves for each size.
1. Solve the top row first and do not disturb it afterwards.
2. Then solve the left column of what remains.
3. Continue layer by layer, so the puzzle becomes smaller and smaller.
4. Finish the last two by two area by rotating the tiles around the gap.
The puzzles are generated so that they can always be solved. Practice makes you faster.

Q: Can I always draw at Tic Tac Toe?
A: Yes, with perfect play from both sides the 3 by 3 game is a draw.

Q: What does Peek do in Sliding Puzzle?
A: Hold it to see the finished picture while you play.

### How to Edit a PDF for Free: Add Text, Sign, Highlight and Cover Mistakes (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-edit-a-pdf-for-free-add-text-sign-and-highlight/)
Many PDFs are not fillable forms, but you still need to write on them: a date, a name, a tick box or a signature. You do not need to install software for this. A browser-based PDF editor opens the file on your own device, lets you place items on the page and saves a new PDF.

#### What you can do
- Edit existing text: click a line and type the change in the same font, size and colour.
- Add text anywhere on a page, with your choice of size and colour.
- Draw a signature with your finger or mouse and place it on the page.
- Insert an image such as a stamp or a scanned signature.
- Add a tick or a cross.
- Highlight lines you want to stand out.
- Cover a mistake with a white box.

#### Step by step
1. Open the PDF Editor and choose your file.
2. Pick Add text and click on the page where the text should start, then type.
3. Drag the purple handle to move an item. For images, signatures and boxes, drag the corner square to resize.
4. Use the arrows to go to the next page and repeat.
5. Press Download edited PDF.

#### How to correct existing text
Choose Edit text and click the line you want to change. The editor reads that line's font, size and colour, covers the old words and writes your new words in the same style. When the PDF still holds the letters you type, the new text is drawn with the PDF's own font. If you type a letter the PDF never used, the editor switches to a close matching font such as a look-alike of Arial, Times or Calibri, so the line still looks natural. Press Enter when you finish, then check the page.
One thing to know: the old words are covered, not erased. They remain hidden in the file and could still be found by copying or searching. So use this for corrections, not for hiding private information. For scanned pages there is no text to select, so use Whiteout and Add text on top.

#### What it cannot do
- Permanently remove the old words from the file or reflow a whole paragraph, which needs desktop PDF software.
- Type in Hindi or other scripts. The built-in font supports basic Latin letters, numbers and common symbols.
- Open a password protected PDF without the password.
- Make a legally certified digital signature. A drawn signature is an image of your handwriting.

#### Why your file stays private
The editor opens and saves the PDF inside your browser. The file is not uploaded, so bank forms and ID copies stay on your device. See our guide on how browser-based tools work for the details.

#### Tips for a clean result
- Zoom the page so you can place text exactly on the line.
- Use the same colour as the rest of the form, usually black or dark blue.
- Open the downloaded file and check every page before you send it.

Q: Will edited text look the same as the rest of the page?
A: For common fonts such as Arial, Times New Roman, Calibri and Courier it usually does. The editor copies the size and colour and matches the background colour. A very decorative font or a photo behind the text can show a small difference, so zoom in and check before you send the file.

Q: Is the signature legally valid?
A: A drawn signature is an image of your handwriting. Many everyday documents accept it, but some need a certified digital signature or a witnessed signature. Check what the receiver requires.

Q: Can I edit a scanned PDF?
A: You can add text, signatures and boxes on top of a scanned page. You cannot change the scanned words, because they are part of the picture.

### How to Rotate, Reorder and Delete PDF Pages, Add Page Numbers and a Watermark (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-rotate-reorder-delete-pdf-pages-add-page-numbers-and-watermark/)
A scanned or merged PDF is often messy: pages sideways, a blank page in the middle, the last page in the wrong place and no page numbers. These four jobs can be done in the browser without uploading the file.

#### Rotate, move and delete pages
1. Open the PDF Page Organizer and choose your file. Wait for the page thumbnails.
2. Use the rotate buttons under a page to turn it left or right.
3. Use the arrow buttons to move a page earlier or later.
4. Use the cross button to remove a page.
5. Press Download PDF.
You can also press Add another PDF to bring in pages from a second file, or Add blank page to insert a blank sheet.

#### Add page numbers
1. Open the PDF Page Numbers and Watermark tool and choose Page numbers.
2. Choose the position, such as bottom centre, and a format such as Page 1 of 10.
3. Set the starting number. If your PDF has a cover page, tick the option to skip the first page.
4. Check the preview and download.

#### Add a watermark
Choose Watermark, type a word such as DRAFT or CONFIDENTIAL and set the size, colour, opacity and angle. A light opacity of 15 to 25 percent keeps the page readable. The watermark is added to every page. Keep a copy of the original file, because the watermark cannot be removed afterwards.

#### Turn PDF pages into images
Use PDF to Image when you need a page as a picture, for example to put it on a slide or post it online. Choose PNG for sharp text or JPG for smaller files, choose the quality and optionally type the pages you want. Download single pages or all of them in a ZIP file.

#### Good order of work
1. Merge your files first with PDF Merge if you have several.
2. Fix the pages in the Page Organizer.
3. Add page numbers last, so the numbers match the final order.
4. Add a watermark if the file must be marked.
All four tools run on your device, so your documents are not uploaded.

Q: Can I undo a watermark?
A: No. Keep your original file. The watermark becomes part of the page in the new PDF.

Q: Why should I add page numbers last?
A: Because the numbers are written on the pages. If you move pages afterwards, the numbers will no longer be in order.

### How to Play Ludo: Rules, Safe Squares and Winning Tips (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/how-to-play-ludo-rules-safe-squares-and-tips/)
Ludo is one of the most played board games in India. It is simple enough for children and still has real decisions in it. Here are the rules as used in our free Ludo game, followed by the tips that matter most.

#### The rules
1. Each player has four tokens in a base. You need a 6 to bring a token onto the track. A 6 also gives you an extra roll.
2. Tokens move clockwise around the board by the number rolled. If you roll three 6s in a row, you lose that turn.
3. If your token lands on a square with an opponent's token, the opponent is sent back to its base and you roll again.
4. Start squares and star squares are safe. A token standing on them cannot be captured.
5. After one full lap, a token turns into its own coloured home column. It needs the exact number to reach the centre.
6. The first player to bring all four tokens to the centre wins.

#### Tips to win more often
- Bring more than one token out early. With only one token on the track you often waste good rolls.
- Prefer moves that end on a safe square, especially when an opponent is one to six squares behind you.
- Capturing is worth more than racing: it costs the opponent a whole lap.
- Keep a token near your home column entry, so a late 6 is not wasted.
- Count the squares. If the opponent sits exactly six squares ahead of you, you have a one in six chance to capture it this roll.

#### Playing with friends on one phone
Choose With friends and 2 or 4 players. The colour whose turn it is shows above the board, so pass the phone around. The game saves your settings in your browser, nothing is uploaded.

Q: Can I play Ludo offline?
A: Once the page has loaded, the game runs in your browser and does not need the internet.

Q: Is the dice fair?
A: Yes. Every roll is a random number from 1 to 6 for every player, including the computer.

Q: What if no token can move?
A: The turn passes to the next player automatically.

### Carrom Rules and Tips for Beginners (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/carrom-rules-and-tips-for-beginners/)
Carrom is India's tabletop game of flicks and angles. You hit a heavy striker with your finger to knock the small coins into the corner pockets. Our online Carrom follows the same ideas, so the tips below help in both.

#### The basics
- There are 9 white coins, 9 black coins and one red queen. One player takes white, the other black.
- Place the striker anywhere on your baseline and flick it. You keep your turn as long as you pocket one of your own coins.
- Pocketing the striker is a foul: one of your pocketed coins returns to the centre.
- The queen must be covered. After pocketing her, pocket one of your own coins in the same turn, otherwise she goes back to the centre.
- The first player to pocket all nine coins wins. The queen adds 3 points.

#### Aiming
Imagine a straight line from the pocket through the coin you want to hit and a little further. The striker has to arrive at that point on the far side of the coin. In the online game, drag the striker to the spot on your baseline that lines up with that point, then pull back in the opposite direction and release.

#### Tips
- Use less power than you think. A slow coin drops into the pocket; a fast one bounces out.
- Use the cushions. A coin near a side wall can be pocketed by bouncing the striker off the wall first.
- Break the centre pile with medium power so coins spread but do not fly into the opponent's pockets.
- Leave the queen until a coin of yours is easy to pocket afterwards, otherwise you lose her again.
- On Hard, the computer rarely misses an open shot, so do not leave your coins hanging near a pocket.

Q: How do I set the power?
A: The red line that appears when you pull back shows the power. A longer line is a harder shot.

Q: Can I pocket the queen first?
A: You can, but she only counts if you pocket one of your coins in the same turn.

Q: Does the game work on phones?
A: Yes. Drag with your finger. Landscape or portrait both work.

### Block Puzzle: 7 Tips to Score Higher and Play Longer (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/block-puzzle-tips-to-score-higher/)
Block puzzle games look like luck, but most games end because of a few avoidable mistakes. These tips apply to our free Block Puzzle and to most block games on phones.
1. Look at all three pieces before placing any of them. Sometimes the order matters.
2. Keep one long straight gap open at all times. The five-block line is the piece that ends most games.
3. Fill from the edges and corners inward, so the middle stays flexible.
4. Never leave single-square holes. Only the one-block piece can fill them, and it does not come often.
5. Set up double clears: a row and a column that will both complete with one piece. They score far more than two separate clears.
6. Place the big 3 by 3 square as soon as it appears. It is the hardest piece to fit later.
7. When the board is almost full, use the small pieces to open a line rather than to score.

#### How scoring works
You get one point for every block you place and a bonus for every line you clear. Clearing two or more lines in one move multiplies the bonus, and clearing on consecutive moves builds a combo. So a patient game that sets up big clears beats a fast one.

Q: Can I rotate pieces in Block Puzzle?
A: No. Pieces are placed as shown, which is why planning matters.

Q: Is there a time limit?
A: No. The game only ends when no piece fits.

Q: Does the game save my best score?
A: Yes, in your own browser. Nothing is uploaded.

### Cricket Batting Game: How to Time Your Shots for Sixes (https://vidnexastudio.com/blog/cricket-batting-game-timing-tips/)
Our Cricket Batting game is all about timing. The ball comes down the pitch and you tap once when it reaches the bat. Here is how the timing zones work and how to score more.

#### The timing zones
- Perfect, right in the yellow zone: six runs.
- Slightly early or late: four runs.
- A bit more off: two runs if early, one run if late.
- Clearly early or late: a dot ball, no run.
- Far too early: caught. Far too late, or no swing at all: bowled.

#### Modes
- 2 overs: 12 balls, 3 wickets, set a high score.
- 5 overs: 30 balls, 3 wickets, a longer innings.
- Chase: beat a random target in 12 balls with 3 wickets.

#### Tips
- Watch the ball, not the bowler. The speed changes from ball to ball.
- In Chase mode, count what you need. If 8 runs are needed from 4 balls, two fours are enough. Do not swing wildly for a six on every ball.
- On Hard the window is small and the ball is fast, so wait a fraction longer than feels natural.
- Three boundaries in a row show a streak. Keep it going for bragging rights, not extra runs.

Q: How many wickets do I get?
A: Three in every mode.

Q: Does the game work with a keyboard?
A: Yes. Press Space or Enter to bowl and to hit.

Q: Is my best score saved?
A: Yes, separately for each mode and bowling level, in your own browser.
